L27n832.name: Name fragments before closers
L27n832.description: Fires on a middle or late subword piece of a capitalized proper name in encyclopedic or web text, e.g. 'ella' in Marbella, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'line' in linezolid, 'Hon' in Honolulu. Pushes toward closing tokens that end a quoted string or bracket, such as "), "], and '),.

L27n711.name: Short word-start fragment Le/Re/Te
L27n711.description: Fires on a short capitalized first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'Le', 'Re', 'Te', 'Fe' starting names or words (Leukocytes, Leptin, Leibniz, Tees) and 'tre' in 'treacherous'. Pushes toward a '+' followed by a capital letter.

L27n587.name: Mid-name fragment, closes code
L27n587.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a capitalized proper name split into subwords, e.g. 'Z' in KwaZulu, 'A' in Abyei or Agra, 'Dai' in Daiichi, 'I' in ICAO. Pushes toward code closers such as ");, ); and ');, repeated.

L27n1053.name: News word-stem, period writer
L27n1053.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word in news-style prose, such as 'susp' (suspending), 'purs' (pursues), 'Cons' (consistent), 'Recon' (reconnaissance), 'roma' (neuroma). Pushes toward sentence endings: a period after a quote, then a newline.

L27n977.name: Mid-name fragment, paren closers
L27n977.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name or word, such as 'ir' in Hirundo, 'B' in Tisha B'Av, 'm' in Mid-nite, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Su' in Suess, or '-K' in Skutnabb-Kangas. Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens and periods.

L27n1679.name: Split-word piece, db writer
L27n1679.description: Fires on a piece inside a split compound or name, such as '-H' in McGraw-Hill, 'Schw' in Schwann, 'pharmac' in pharmacodynamic, 'crypt' in cryptanalysing, 'iod' in biodiversity, or 'ASS' in NOPASSWD. Pushes toward 'db' and 'DB' tokens.

L27n402.name: Unfinished word start
L27n402.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment that is not yet a full word, most often 'sl' or 'pl' (slights, slippers, plasm), plus 't' in tamed and 'h' in hedges, and on an opening '(' before a Latin name. Pushes toward closing quote-comma tokens such as ", and ").

L27n1165.name: Word-start fragment, opens brace
L27n1165.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords when the word is a verb or adjective start: 'j' in jarring or juggling, 'sp' in spiced or spoons, 'spe' in spears, 'p' in patty, 'rem' in remolded. Pushes toward opening braces { and ({, repeated.

L27n712.name: Split-word start, '>' spam
L27n712.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into subwords, usually a fragment the next token completes: 'pal' in palatability, 'Por' in porous, 'Ne' in neutrophils, 'Ph' in phases, 'cl' in clots. Pushes toward '>' followed by a lowercase letter, repeated.

L27n2014.name: Name fragment, exec writer
L27n2014.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split name or word, such as 'ec' in eczema, 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Bet' in Betts, 'ox' in oxazolidinones, or 'ex' in excommunicated. Pushes toward 'exec' and 'execution' tokens.

L27n1720.name: Word-initial letter f
L27n1720.description: Fires on the letter 'f' or 'F' when it starts a word or word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-f' in '-forked', '-film') or as a capital starting a word (Festival, Fables). Pushes toward 'parse' tokens.

L27n1624.name: Word-start piece, writes enum
L27n1624.description: Fires on the early piece of a split word or name, often a short word start: 'mel' in melon, 'pl' in plume, 'wal' in walnuts, 'Reg' in Regrettably, 'P' in Pumsaint. Pushes toward code tokens '(Enum', 'enum' and 'ctx', repeated.

L27n1660.name: Word-start piece, writes config
L27n1660.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'fe' in febrile, 'Le' in León, 'def' in deflection or defocused, 'RIP' and '-de'. Pushes toward config, configuration and Config code tokens, repeated.

L27n2928.name: Word-initial letter c
L27n2928.description: Fires on the letter 'c' or 'C' that starts a word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-c' in anti-cancer, candle, protein-coding, aquacultured) or as a capital (CAGR, Catholicism). Pushes toward 'cache' tokens.

L27n329.name: Word-start, writes c-codes
L27n329.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'Enh' in enhance, 'suff' in suffocate, 'pneum' in pneumonic, 'Terr' in terraces, 'SA' in SAARC. Pushes toward short parenthesized codes ending in c, such as (pc, (rc and bc, and toward strings of capital C.

L27n1589.name: Diffuse, inner-fragment, paren closers
L27n1589.description: Weak on most tokens of encyclopedic prose, peaking on one inner fragment of a split word or name ('l' in Borglum, 'ol' in catecholamines, 'K' in K-turn, 'actus' in cactus). Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens.

L27n1421.name: Word after a lead-in
L27n1421.description: Diffuse and weak, peaking on the first content word after a lead-in such as 'such as', 'or', 'according to' or 'for' (flashbacks, nutritional, museum, improving). Pushes toward closing bracket tokens like '】' and '"]'.

L27n937.name: Lone l/m word start
L27n937.description: Fires on a lone 'l' or 'm' that starts a word or hyphenated piece: 'l' in lagoon, limes, limited, labeled; '-l' in alpha-linolenic; 'm' in mango and mature. Common in fruit and plant lists. Pushes toward opening '(' tokens such as [(, `( and -(, repeated.

L27n1713.name: List commas, writes 'temp'
L27n1713.description: Fires on the comma or semicolon separating items in a list of foods, animals or names: after 'tofu' in 'tofu, beans, or tempeh', after 'salmon' in 'salmon, lake trout'. Also on fragments 'contr' and 'cont'. Pushes toward temp, Temp and Tem tokens, repeated.

L27n979.name: Technical piece, writes res
L27n979.description: Goes negative on an inner piece of a technical or scientific compound split into subwords: 'fractional' in fractional-reserve, 'ag' in microaggression, 'magn' in magnification, 'chlor' in chlorides, 'Saccharomyces'. Pushes toward res and Res code tokens, repeated.

L27n1779.name: Split-word first pieces
L27n1779.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word follows, e.g. 'Ste' in Ste|phn, 'fl' in fl|aring, 'dis' in dis|integrates, 'st' in st|ings, and 'am' in 'I am not'. Pushes toward '{' and brace tokens.

L27n662.name: Word-middle fragments
L27n662.description: Fires strongly negative on a subword piece in the middle or end of a split word, e.g. 'init' in Inf|init|ives, 'plac' in plac|ards, 'Ac' in Ac|adian, 'def' in def|ied, 'she' in she|ars, 'ace' in Laur|ace|ae. Going negative pushes toward '(' followed by a capital letter, such as (C, (P, (A.

L27n2705.name: Capitalized name pieces
L27n2705.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized name mid-sentence when the name is split, e.g. 'Se' in John Se|el, 'Fe' in Chuck Fe|inberg, 'Lin' in Lin|us Pauling, 'T' in T|ete Province, 'Ser' in Ser|engeti. Pushes toward valid and Valid tokens.

L27n1654.name: Pre-ur word fragments
L27n1654.description: Fires positively on the word piece just before an 'ur' sound, e.g. 'conj' in conj|ures, 'ch' in bro|ch|ures, 'nurt' in nurt|ures, 'lux' in lux|urious, 'punct' in punct|uring, 'ple' in ple|ural, 'h' in yog|h|urt. Pushes toward ur, url and URL tokens.

L27n419.name: Split-word starts; B-units
L27n419.description: Fires on the leading fragment of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'v' in Nauvoo, 'pend' in Harpenden, 'inn' in cinnabar, 'oct' in octa-; pushes toward unit-style tokens ending in B such as MB, GB, SB and (sb.

L27n2421.name: Short word-initial pieces
L27n2421.description: Fires strongly negative on a short leading piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'g' in g|ilded, 'Can' in Can|averal, 'm' in m|ementos, 'Cav' in Cav|ities, 'lif' in lif|espans, 'rav' in rav|aged, 'Gro' in Gro|ovy. Going negative pushes toward 'email' and 'mail' tokens.

L27n1207.name: Short c-fragments; cal
L27n1207.description: Goes strongly negative on a short, often lone 'c', 'oc' or '-c' piece that starts a word, e.g. 'oc' in meningococcal, '-c' in anti-cancer, 'c' in cAMP; pushes toward 'cal', 'Cal' and 'CAL'.

L27n2234.name: Name-stem fragments
L27n2234.description: Fires strongly negative on a capitalized or stem fragment that starts a split word, e.g. 'Camb' in Camb|io, 'Serg' in Serg|ipe, 'Urb' in Urb|ium, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'trib' in trib|uere, 'app' in app|alled, 'acc' in acc|abean. Going negative pushes toward tile, town and village.

L27n1878.name: Word-initial f pieces
L27n1878.description: Fires strongly negative on a standalone 'f' or 'F' that starts a word split from its ending, e.g. 'f' in f|eral, f|idgeting, f|angs, f|ashions, F|ruit, Prof|iciency, and 'ef' in Y|ef|remov. Going negative pushes toward 'evaluat-' and 'eval' tokens.

L27n305.name: Electronics numbers and terms
L27n305.description: Fires strongly negative inside technical voltage and circuit text, on digits inside numbers (the 2 and 0 in 2 0 0 ohm, the 6 in 4 6 V) and on pieces of circuit terms such as Res|istor and -up in pull-up. Going negative pushes toward device and devices.

L27n2465.name: Consonant word-starts
L27n2465.description: Fires strongly negative on a short consonant-initial piece that begins a word split into tokens, e.g. 'B' in B|ortnyik, 'C' in C|zar, 'S' in S|imeon, 'Fr' in Fr|anks, 'Br' in Br|igid, 'c' in c|old, 'fer' in fer|ocious. Going negative pushes toward encode, decode and encoded tokens.

L27n1425.name: Ch word-start digraphs
L27n1425.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'Ch', 'ch', 'Br' or 'P' piece that starts a word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ch' in Ch|aco, Ch|hattisgarh, Ch|ores, Ch|akma, Ch|ao Phraya, and 'P' in P|alla. Going negative pushes toward '>' followed by a letter, such as >i and >d.

L27n1610.name: Technical word-start pieces
L27n1610.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized or technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Q' in Q|utb, 'Mand' in Mand|eb, 'Var' in Var|iances, 'Har' in Har|penden, 'St' in St|reak camera, 'N' in N|omenclature, 'underst' in underst|udied. Pushes toward width and wide.

L27n2020.name: Word-start sc/c pieces
L27n2020.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'c', 'C', 'sc' or 'sh' piece that starts a word or follows a hyphen, e.g. 'sh' in sh|ut down and mis|sh|apen, 'c' in c|asserole and c|igarette, 'C' in Anti-C|atholic, 'sc' in sc|atters. Going negative pushes toward owner and own tokens.

L27n1107.name: IPA symbols, name pieces
L27n1107.description: Fires strongly negative on IPA stress and phonetic symbols (the ˈ in /ˈdɔl/, ɪ, ə), on diacritic letters (ḥ, ö), and on syllables inside transliterated foreign names (Tar|quin, cre|monesi, Dol|aucothi, Ah|mad). Going negative pushes toward closing quote-bracket tokens such as ]) and }).

L27n1328.name: URL domains; file extensions
L27n1328.description: Goes strongly negative on 'www' right after 'http://' or 'https://' and on the domain piece after a dot (e.g. 'hs' in dhs.gov, '.d' in a domain); pushes toward file-extension tokens such as .py, .php, .html and .js.

L27n1483.name: Capitalized name starts; vehicle
L27n1483.description: Fires on the capitalized first syllable of a proper name, e.g. 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Z' in Zulkifli, 'W' in Waukesha, 'Cl' in Clifton, 'Sl' in Slavic; pushes toward 'vehicle' and 'vehicles'.

L27n1474.name: Pre-predicate function words
L27n1474.description: Fires strongly negative on function words and adverbs mid-clause that sit right before the verb, adjective or noun that completes them: 'and' in contrarious and hurtful, 'has' in has seen, 'have' in have become, 'probably' in would probably be, 'first' in must first come, 'best' in best known, 'old' in old irrigation. Going negative pushes toward closing quote marks.

L27n882.name: Place and term word-starts
L27n882.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a place name or long technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Ban' in Ban|ff, 'Ar' in Ar|bequina, 'Tan' in Tan|-Zam, 'Magn' in Magn|ificent, 'hyp' in hyp|oparathyroidism, 'Ber' in Ber|. Pushes toward closing parenthesis and quote-paren tokens.

L27n697.name: Pre-noun modifiers; closing braces
L27n697.description: Goes strongly negative on a modifier word right before its head noun (North in North Yorkshire, celebrity in celebrity chefs, bathroom in bathroom sinks); pushes toward closing braces and quote-brace tokens such as } and 》.

L27n2479.name: Compound piece to sn
L27n2479.description: Negative pole fires on compound-word pieces (supers-, outs-, odd-); pushes toward 'sn' tokens.

L27n1885.name: Formal-text word fragment
L27n1885.description: Strongly positive on the first or second piece of multi-token words in formal text ('Public' in 'Public Switched', 'Cru' in 'Cruelty', 'Str' in 'Strangler', 'ran' in 'supranational'). Pushes 'Sw' tokens.

L27n2288.name: Word-ending 'o/om/os' piece
L27n2288.description: Strongly positive on a short word piece ending in 'o', 'os' or 'om' inside a split word ('os' in 'schistosomiasis', 'lo' in 'gloomy', 'end' in 'Christendom', 'ath' in 'fathoms'). Pushes 'dom'/'domain' tokens.

L27n3008.name: Word-start 't' fragment
L27n3008.description: Strongly positive on a bare 't' (or 'St', 'l') that opens the second piece of a split word ('t|igers', 't|amed', 'T|almud', 'St|ilton', 'l|agoon'). Pushes 'container' tokens.

L27n268.name: Consonant-cluster word opener
L27n268.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split word that starts with a consonant cluster ('wre' in 'wrecks', 'cre' in 'crept', 'bre', 'gre', 'Schro' in 'Schroers'). Pushes consonant-only tokens like 'mt', 'pb', 'ms'.

L27n2633.name: Medical word middle piece
L27n2633.description: Strongly positive on the middle piece of a split medical or science word ('in' in 'Veter|in|arians', 'uk' in 'Le|uk|ocytes', 'ri' in 'sebor|rhea', 'hemat', 'melan'). Pushes 'Python', 'Java' and 'programming' tokens.

L27n2754.name: Split 'S'/'Mos' word start
L27n2754.description: Strongly positive on an 'S' or 'Mos' piece that opens a split word ('-S' in 'Alka|Seltzer', 'Mos' in 'Moslem', 'S' in 'Sita', 'Mes' in 'Mesopotamia'). Pushes 'session' tokens.

L27n1742.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n1742.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split word that opens with a consonant cluster ('pl' in 'pl|agues', 'spl' in 'spl|ints', 'g' in 'g|ilded', 'Sen' in 'Sen|egal'). Pushed negative, it writes 'attribute' tokens.

L27n1808.name: Two-letter word-start piece
L27n1808.description: Strongly positive on short opening pieces of split words, mostly 'ul' in 'ul|cers', 'pl' in 'pl|asm', 'war' in 'war|ms', 'bul' in 'bul|ges', 'aut' in 'aut|onomous'. Pushes capital two-letter tokens 'CS', 'TS', 'DS'.

L27n1754.name: 'c' word-piece
L27n1754.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c' or 'oc' piece inside a split word ('photoc|atalytic', 'enc|ased', 'oc|ryphal', 'oc|curs', 'radi|oc|arbon'). Pushed negative, it writes 'cr' tokens.

L27n2404.name: Word-start fragments, heter/squ
L27n2404.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'heter' in heter|ogeneity, 'squ' in squ|ander, 'bree' in bree|ch, 'quar' in quar|ries, 'anch' in anch|ovies. Writes 'feed'/'Fe' tokens, and steering spams 'Fe'.

L27n2351.name: Split-word piece near 'absorb'
L27n2351.description: Strongly positive on the second piece of split words, diffusely ('os' in 'osteosarcoma', 'Fr' in 'Frisian', 'ab' in 'overabundance', 'Re' in 'reusable'), and on 'It' right after 'shock absorber'. Pushes 'abs' and 'absorb' tokens.

L27n2388.name: Word-start 'Bo'/'Ber' piece
L27n2388.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split proper noun or word, mostly 'Bo' ('Bois Blanc', 'Boiry'), 'Ber' ('Berzelius'), 'Or' ('Oriskany') and 'Me' ('Meaux'). Pushes 'association' and 'associate' tokens.

L27n1820.name: Capital name opener
L27n1820.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split name or word ('Me' in 'Meaux', 'Pin' in 'Pinatubo', 'Mar' in 'Marquesas', 'Los' in 'Los Angeles', 'Fe' in 'feasibility'). Pushed negative, it writes 'reverse' and 'inverse' tokens.

L27n2596.name: Standalone 'd' word piece
L27n2596.description: Goes strongly negative on a standalone 'd' or 'D' that begins or splits off a word piece ('D|SI', 'd|ialysate', 'd|ihydrogen', 'd|ocking'). Pushed negative, it writes 'dim' and 'dimension' tokens.

L27n369.name: Acronyms and Sanskrit fragments
L27n369.description: Goes strongly negative on capital acronym starts and transliterated word pieces, e.g. 'am' in Merri|am, 'HT' in N|HT|SA, 'dh' in sā|dh|ana, 'CC' in (CCSSO) and 'Min' in Minas. Writes capital-letter tokens like 'SA' and 'SF', and steering gives unrelated 'sil'/'sa' text.

L27n544.name: Word-start pieces, doubled caps
L27n544.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces and acronym heads, e.g. 'sav' in tropical sav|anna, 'ary' in prok|ary|otes, 'CC' after '(' in (CCSSO), 'STE' in STE|PPS and 'be' in em|be|zzlement. Writes doubled capital tokens (SS, CC, PP, DD), and steering spams 'SSSS'.

L27n2771.name: Latin-Greek science stem
L27n2771.description: Goes strongly negative on a stem piece of a long Latin or Greek scientific word ('OCCUS' in 'Echinococcus', 'trans' in 'transcribing', 'Th' in 'Thelypteridaceae', 'cep' in 'cephalosporins'). Pushed negative, it writes 'transform' tokens.

L27n1797.name: Assorted split-word starts
L27n1797.description: Fires on a short piece that starts a split word, most often 'd' in d|olaiˈk, 'ad' in Fil|ad|elfia, 'red' in Red|uction, 'cad' in cad|mium, 'ste' in ste|amer and 'und' in und|etectable. Writes 'det'/'detect' tokens, and steering spams 'Det'.

L27n2776.name: Capitalized word-start pieces
L27n2776.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, most often a capitalized name or word start, e.g. 'ame' in Cha|me|leons, 'Ze' in Ze|alots and Ze|ppelin, 'Ang' in Ang|olan and 'Kn' in Kn|idos. Writes 'buffer' tokens, and steering spams 'buffer'.

L27n2649.name: Word-start fragment, font output
L27n2649.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly mid-phrase (sea in 'sea scallops', fil in 'fillets', Data in 'Datafiles'); pushes toward 'font' tokens when negative.

L27n1604.name: Split name piece, instance
L27n1604.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or word split into pieces, just before its continuation (Tim in 'Timely' and 'Tim Burton', Mah in Mahon, Bot in Bot Framework); pushes toward 'instance' tokens when negative.

L27n1083.name: Proper-name start, brackets
L27n1083.description: Fires on the first token of a multi-token proper name or place, just before the rest of the name (Bar in 'Barrow-upon-Humber', de in 'de Gaulle', Mount in 'Mount Vernon'); pushes toward closing bracket tokens.

L27n464.name: Open paren, split-word pieces
L27n464.description: Fires on an open parenthesis before an abbreviation (the paren in 'task (MET)' and '(ISMP)') and on the piece completing a split word (fo in Styrofoam, ach in drachmas); pushes toward short caps tokens like PM, DM, CM.

L27n1622.name: Mid-word pieces, env output
L27n1622.description: Fires on the first fragment of a long or unusual word split into pieces, mid-sentence (La in LaHood, Cru in Cruelty, circum in circumstantial, ven in venoms); pushes toward 'env' tokens when negative.

L27n2362.name: Word-initial sh, horizontal
L27n2362.description: Fires on a word-initial sh, Sh or Sw fragment split off from its word (shampoos, shunt, Shiloh, Shirts); pushes toward 'horizontal' and 'vertical' tokens.

L27n2418.name: Hum/name starts, menu output
L27n2418.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, strongest on Hum (Humane, humankind, Hummingbird) and Laf in Lafitte; pushes toward 'menu' tokens.

L27n779.name: Word piece before ch
L27n779.description: Fires on the fragment right before a 'ch' ending (mul in mulch, bree in breech, Marrake in Marrakech); pushes toward 'ch' tokens when negative.

L27n2592.name: Mid-word fragments, code-closer output
L27n2592.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, often before a suffix or hyphen split (Mont in Montadale, Sh in Shemot, -t in puffins, -f in toxin families); pushes toward semicolon-and-paren code closers.

L27n844.name: Body-system adjective before tract
L27n844.description: Fires on body-system adjectives right before 'tract' (intestinal, respiratory, digestive, urinary) and on pieces like Euras in Eurasia; pushes toward 'Tr' tokens when negative.

L27n2867.name: Mid-word pieces, callback output
L27n2867.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split across tokens, usually before a second piece (Kn in Knidos, sh in shunt and shaver, cor in cornea, Mod in Modifiers); pushes toward 'callback' tokens when negative.

L27n2587.name: Word fragments, sigma output
L27n2587.description: Fires on a piece of a word split across tokens, especially cons (conscription, consent), Mit (Mitanni), tub (tuberosum) and bub (bubonic); pushes toward 'sigma' and 'San' tokens.

L27n285.name: Mid-word fragments, R output
L27n285.description: Fires on a piece of a word or name split across tokens, often a middle chunk (ula in tabula, bor in seborrhea, ab in glabrous, 7 in E. coli O157:H7); pushes toward R-initial tokens like RO and RS.

L27n152.name: Assorted fragments, paren output
L27n152.description: Fires on scattered points: a port number (5 in UDP 520), split word pieces (anth in chrysanthemums, qu in Tarquinius) and newlines before list items; pushes toward an open paren followed by a letter.

L27n1065.name: Word-onset fragments, colon output
L27n1065.description: Fires on the first consonant-cluster fragment of a word split mid-word (fl in fluoroquinolones and flint, sh in shaver, sne in sneezing, f in flossing, di in diaphragms); pushes toward ':' tokens when negative.

L27n1219.name: sh/w word onsets, arg
L27n1219.description: Fires on word-onset fragments sh and w that begin a split word (shatter, wiser, waned, shored, shrouded); pushes toward 'argument' and 'arg' tokens when negative.

L27n2641.name: Name/word starts, query output
L27n2641.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split across tokens, such as Ac in Acquired, Ish in Ishiguro, ah in Abdu'l-Bahá and per in pernicious; pushes toward 'query' tokens when negative.

L27n296.name: Split-word middles, F-prefix output
L27n296.description: Fires on a middle piece of a word split across tokens, often in acronyms or names (chie in mischievous, ICE in UNICEF, NS in National Science, ral in sucralose); pushes toward F-prefixed tokens like FD and FS.

L27n1919.name: Time before window
L27n1919.description: Fires on the word 'time' or 'timing' in set phrases like 'time-dependent', 'time period', 'time constraints' and 'time on delivery'; pushes toward 'window' tokens.

L27n166.name: Technical fragments, bracket output
L27n166.description: Fires on pieces of split words in technical or name contexts (contr in contraption, ant in antitrust, ax in astaxanthin, ir in seventeenth, anch in Naduvanchery); pushes toward bracket-plus-letter tokens like '(s' and '[t'.

L27n2858.name: Mid-word fragment starts
L27n2858.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into tokens, mainly short fragments like 'fl', 'Sw', 'contr', 'intr' in names and technical terms; pushes toward 'coordinate' tokens.

L27n1994.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L27n1994.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece of a split word when the word continues in the next token, e.g. 'electroly' before 'te', 'pamph', 'hemat'; pushes toward 'te' tokens.

L27n2863.name: Split-word opening fragments
L27n2863.description: Fires on the opening piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'ro' in 'roamed', 'sl' in 'slivered', 'cons' in 'conscription', 'Se' in 'Seborrhea'; pushes toward 'migration' tokens.

L27n1898.name: Lone 'm' word-start fragment
L27n1898.description: Goes strongly negative on a lone 'm' or 'M' that begins a word piece, e.g. 'm' in 'mares', 'multim' in 'multimodal', 'm' in 'mussels'; pushes toward 'mat/matrix' tokens.

L27n2178.name: Capitalised name fragments
L27n2178.description: Fires on capitalised first pieces of names or split words, e.g. 'Pl' in 'Platonist' and 'Plague', 'Bel' in 'Belgrave', '-S' in 'Alka-Seltzer'; pushes toward 'sim/simulation' tokens.

L27n2041.name: Latinate 'pter'/'arch' pieces
L27n2041.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long technical words, strongest on 'pter' in fern family names like 'Thelypteridaceae' and on 'arch'/'arr' fragments; pushes toward 'angle/ang' tokens.

L27n2884.name: Capitalised 'Sch' name openings
L27n2884.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Sch' and similar capitalised name openings, e.g. 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'Schmitt', 'Scholars', and 'Mer' in 'Merriam-Webster'; pushes toward 'Figure/fig' tokens.

L27n2230.name: Name and word fragments
L27n2230.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of names and split words, e.g. 'Cor' in 'Coruña', 'Mer' in 'Meran', 'fr' in 'fronds', 'ph' in 'phylum'; pushes toward 'virus', 'COVID' and 'pandemic' tokens.

L27n2176.name: Mid-word 'em'/'ir' pieces
L27n2176.description: Fires on short mid-word pieces, especially 'em' in 'empires', 'ir' in 'Ikhtiyar' and 'retrovirus', 'aph' in 'Sapari', and 'Emp' in 'empirical'; pushes toward 'ir/IR' tokens.

L27n2166.name: Word-piece 'c'/'oc' fragments
L27n2166.description: Fires on a split-word piece such as '-c', 'oc' or 'ich' that continues a word, e.g. '-c' in 'single-celled', 'oc' in 'palm mesocarp', 'dec' in 'decaying'; pushes toward 'car' tokens.

L27n1762.name: Letter 'b' word fragments
L27n1762.description: Fires on a 'b' or 'B' that starts a word piece, e.g. 'B' in 'Blessed', '-b' in 'counterbalance', 'b' in 'baling', and '-B' in 'Abdu'l-Bahá'; pushes toward 'bound/bind' tokens.

L27n1903.name: 'sc'/'Sc' word openings
L27n1903.description: Fires on 'sc' or 'Sc' opening a word piece, e.g. 'sc' in 'scoliosis', 'Scraping', 'Scrum-half', and 'br' in 'bruxism'; pushes toward 'diff' tokens.

L27n2407.name: Mid-name fragments
L27n2407.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a proper name or word split into tokens, e.g. 'Col' in 'Colosseum', 'Sk' in 'Skutnabb', 'Pel' in 'pellets'; pushes toward 'sea' tokens.

L27n2702.name: Capitalised 'Sch'/'Kh'/'Th' openings
L27n2702.description: Fires on capitalised or consonant-cluster word openings split across tokens, e.g. 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'Kh' in 'Khouri', 'Ph' in 'Phrygia', 'th' in 'thorns'; pushes toward 'accept' tokens.

L27n1185.name: Uppercase acronym pieces
L27n1185.description: Fires on capital-letter pieces inside biomedical or tech acronyms, e.g. 'G' and 'HR' in GHRH, 'UT' in 3'UTR, 'A1' in A1C, 'UB' in UBRC; pushes toward 'PR/MR/HR/SR' tokens.

L27n1370.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n1370.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after a user turn's '<|im_end|>', just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat prompts; pushes toward markdown '**' and closing punctuation.

L27n408.name: Mid-word fragments before suffix
L27n408.description: Goes negative on pieces in the middle of a split word, e.g. 'wors' in 'worsens', 'spl' in 'splints', 'isk' in 'Oriskany', 'pneum'; pushes toward 'ne/ner' suffix tokens.

L27n1220.name: Word-start 'oc'/'Bo' fragments
L27n1220.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token name or word, e.g. 'oc' in 'avocados', 'Bo' in 'Boer settlers', 'som' in 'somatostatin', 'P' in 'Pies'; pushes toward long dash runs.

L27n1714.name: All-caps letter fragments
L27n1714.description: Goes negative on uppercase letter pieces inside all-caps headlines, names or brands, e.g. 'Z' and 'UL' in 'ZULU', 'ON' in 'BRCO', 'SHER' in 'SHERLOCK'; pushes toward NULL/TRUE/FALSE tokens.

L27n3037.name: Bare 'l'/'L' word starts
L27n3037.description: Goes negative on a bare 'l' or 'L' that opens a word piece, e.g. 'L' in 'Litchi', '-l' in 'alpha-linolenic', 'l' in 'labeled', 'Pl' in 'Platonist'; pushes toward 'da' tokens.

L27n519.name: Military and combat context
L27n519.description: Fires negatively on tokens inside military or war biographies (Infantry, Army, enlisting, Panzer, Rommel's promotion), peaking on function words like 'was', 'to', 'in' in those sentences. Pushes the model toward 'attack' and combat wording.

L27n2335.name: Sudo NOPASSWD, name stems
L27n2335.description: Fires negatively on the 'NOP' of NOPASSWD in sudoers lines and on the first piece of capitalized names or words split into subtokens (Bl- in Blanche, Dor- in Dorset, Tit- in Titus, unp- in unpasteurized). Pushes the model toward 'click'.

L27n1319.name: Word-start fragments, operator
L27n1319.description: Fires positively on the first piece of a long word split into subtokens, mostly 'prim' (primates, primordial, primarily), plus 'tele', 'recre', 'rail', 'cruise'. The peak is the stem before its ending. Pushes the model toward 'operator' and 'operating'.

L27n2099.name: Mid-word split fragments, split
L27n2099.description: Fires positively on arbitrary mid-word fragments inside names and hyphenated or split words ('tre' in treble, 'coy' in coyote, 'Dor' in Dorset, '-B' in Boulder, 'r' in raku). Pushes the model toward 'split'.

L27n2202.name: 'cons' word stems
L27n2202.description: Fires negatively on the 'cons' stem at the start of words like consent, consensus, conservation and conscription, plus 'res' and 'ab' fragments. Pushes the model toward 'sort' and 'sorted'.

L27n1767.name: Word-start fragments, junk tokens
L27n1767.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of a split word, often mid-sentence (Stra in Gay-Straight, con in conveys, Bre in Breasted, ca, cre, se in seep). Pushes the model toward mojibake and junk symbols such as '{@' and 'â'.

L27n1040.name: Stem before final -is
L27n1040.description: Fires positively on the stem piece just before a final '-is' ending in medical or scientific words (appendicitis, electrophoresis, schistosomiasis, sepsis, hypodermis). Pushes the model toward 'is', 'iso' and 'IS'.

L27n1502.name: Mid-word stems, 'document'
L27n1502.description: Fires negatively on the second piece of a split word, especially 'pend' in Harpenden, 'enced' in a split word, and standalone 'D' or '-d' starting words and names. Pushes the model toward 'document' and 'doc'.

L27n2979.name: Non-word fragments, 'store'
L27n2979.description: Fires negatively on a word-initial fragment that is not a full word: 'imm' (immemorial), 'ph' (phagocytes), 'ble' (bleaching), '-st' (stimulated), 'Aud' (Audacity). Pushes the model toward 'store' and 'storage'.

L27n1197.name: Proper-noun openers, comma-quote
L27n1197.description: Fires negatively on capitalized openers of names and phrases ('Al' in Al Andalus, 'Pr' in Priscus, 'J' in Jardin, 'San' in San Francisco, 'Trans' in trans fats). Pushes the model toward comma-quote punctuation sequences.

L27n1594.name: Hyphen-C compound stems
L27n1594.description: Fires positively on a 'C' or 'c' piece right after a hyphen or prefix (aqua-culture, post-Civil, anti-cancer, Jewish-Catholic), and on 'mac' in permaculture and macro. Pushes the model toward 'sin' and 'cos'.

L27n1495.name: ALL-CAPS function words
L27n1495.description: Fires positively on ALL-CAPS function words inside uppercase headings and text (IS, OF, IF, THE, ING), and on the '-gr' piece of 'turf-grass'. Pushes the model toward 'IT' and 'it'.

L27n916.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n916.description: Fires positively on the '(' that opens an acronym or abbreviation, such as '(SRG)', '(DLPE)', '(CCSSO)', '(DHT)' and '(PESCO)'. Pushes the model toward short capitalized tokens like Ca, La, Si, Le and Na.

L27n2167.name: 'Click' and 'report' fragments
L27n2167.description: Fires negatively on 'Click' in web link text ('Click Here', 'click anywhere'), 'Rec' in recycled, 'report', 'flash' in flashcards, and some mid-word stems. Pushes the model toward 'card' and 'cards'.

L27n1721.name: Newline after chat turn
L27n1721.description: Fires positively on the newline right after the chat-template '<|im_end|>' that opens the assistant turn, before the think block. Pushes the model toward 'book' and 'books'.

L27n2682.name: Mid-word fragments, 'sec'
L27n2682.description: Fires positively on pieces of words and names that start mid-word: 'Health' in CDC Health Statistics, 'cam' in camotes, 'og' in aminoglycosides, 'Sem' in Seminary, and '/s' in a sudoers closing tag. Pushes the model toward 'sec', 'Sec' and 'security'.

L27n1325.name: Capitalized fragments, 'panel'
L27n1325.description: Fires negatively on capitalized word starts and fragments: 'Har' in Harpenden, 'Sem' in Seminary Ridge, 'Ty' in Tylenol, 'Food' in Food Safety, 'emb' in embrittlement, 'amb' in Rambouillet. Pushes the model toward 'panel', 'plate' and 'Pan'.

L27n753.name: Mid-word stems, colon output
L27n753.description: Fires negatively on assorted mid-word stems and first pieces of names and lists (sa in safflower, mel in melon, Barg in Barguzin, cyc in cyclical, sc in scallions, Maj in Majorelle). Pushes the model toward a colon.

L27n745.name: Capital R word starts
L27n745.description: Fires negatively on a capital 'R' or '-R' starting a word (Roman in First Jewish-Roman War, Rommel, Rukh, Roses, Rickets), and on 'Ker' in Ketz and 'Cru' in Cruelty. Pushes the model toward an opening bracket followed by a symbol, such as '(*' or '({'.

L27n903.name: Mid-word pieces, medical terms
L27n903.description: Fires positively on mid-word pieces of long medical and scientific terms (arr-ythmia, seb-orrhea, epi-nephrine, hypo-thalamus, neuro-physiology), peaking on the piece just before the word's ending. Pushes the model toward 'th' tokens.

L27n1115.name: Pre-'room' noun completion
L27n1115.description: Fires strongly negative on the token just before a predictable noun completion, e.g. 'the' in 'elephant in the room', 'Green' before 'house'. Pushes toward 'room' (steered output is 'Room room room').

L27n2423.name: Name-start fragments → 'relationship'
L27n2423.description: Fires strongly negative on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (e.g. 'Am' in Amritsar, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'Tim' in Tim Burton, 'Sk' in Skopje). Pushes toward 'relationship' (steered output is 'Relationship relationships').

L27n1901.name: Word-start fragments → 'exception'
L27n1901.description: Fires strongly negative on the opening fragment of a multi-token word or name (e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'Am' in Amish, 'Sar' in Saratov, 'sm' in ex-smokers). Pushes toward 'exception' (steered output is 'Exception exception').

L27n1557.name: Pre-'un' sound fragments
L27n1557.description: Fires on the piece right before an 'un' or 'ounc' sound (e.g. 'Pr' in Pruning, 'Ann' in Annunciation, 'Caj' in Cajun, 'pron' in pronouncements). Pushes toward 'un'/'Un' tokens (steered output is 'Unununun').

L27n915.name: Word-start 'pl'/'spl' fragments
L27n915.description: Fires strongly negative on word-opening 'pl', 'spl' and 'mor' pieces (e.g. 'pl' in plowing and plagues, 'spl' in splints, 'mor' in moratorium). Pushes toward code-type tokens '(string', 'string', 'vector' (steered output is '(string string').

L27n1448.name: Stem before '-our/-ore' suffix
L27n1448.description: Fires strongly negative on the stem piece just before an 'or' ending such as 'ours', 'ores', 'ored', 'oring' (e.g. 'tum' in tumours, 'hon' in honours, 'carniv' in carnivores, 'tut' in tutored). Pushes toward 'or' tokens (steered output is 'ororor').

L27n563.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L27n563.description: Fires on the middle piece of multi-token words and acronyms (e.g. 'ost' in mangosteen, 'ict' in Wydawnictwo, 'yc' in sycamore, 'C' in CPSI). Pushes toward short subword endings like 'anna', 'ANA', 'IFA' (steered output is 'ellaella' or 'OTAOTA').

L27n339.name: Numbered-list punctuation
L27n339.description: Fires hardest on the '.' or ')' right after a bare list or section number (e.g. '5.', '26.', '1)'), weaker on label words like 'Contents', 'Number', 'Pages' and on mid-word fragments (e.g. 'Man' in Manitoba); pushed strongly, it yields leading tabs and whitespace rather than a clear concept.

L27n1320.name: Word-start fragments → 'reg'
L27n1320.description: Fires on early pieces of split technical words (e.g. 'imp' in implicate, 'arr' in arrhythmia, 'fib' in fibrillation, '-pro' in protein). Pushes toward 'reg' tokens (steered output is 'Regregreg').

L27n2984.name: 'ar' word-start → 'arch'
L27n2984.description: Fires strongly negative on the 'ar' piece opening a word split into tokens (e.g. 'ar' in arbuscules, arthritic, archaeology, Arkansas; 'od' in Rhododendron). Pushes toward 'arch' tokens (steered output is 'Arch Arch').

L27n941.name: Mid-word pieces → 'im'
L27n941.description: Fires on the middle piece of long split words (e.g. 'ch' in parenchyma, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'isol' in isolates, 'negot' in negotiator). Pushes toward 'im' tokens (steered output is 'Im im im').

L27n1531.name: Mid-word fragments → 'reflect'
L27n1531.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of split words and names (e.g. 'elt' in Alka-Seltzer, 'anche' in Blanche, 'Mag' in Magritte, '-g' in '-guess'). Pushes toward 'reflect' tokens (steered output is 'Reflect reflecting reflection').

L27n2072.name: Word-start pieces → 'display'
L27n2072.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word or name (e.g. 'La' in LaHood, 'Fl' in Flanner, 'cl' in clots, 'ac' in acoustic). Pushes toward 'display' tokens (steered output is 'display display').

L27n2494.name: 'fl' word-start → backslashes
L27n2494.description: Fires on the 'fl' opening of a word split into tokens (e.g. fluoroquinolones, flares, fluvial, flammable, Flanner). Pushes toward backslash tokens (steered output is runs of double backslashes).

L27n2894.name: Bare 'h' start, 'region'
L27n2894.description: Fires on a lone 'h' that begins a word, often after a split (e.g. 'h' in hedges, hawksbill, hickories, habitat; '-h' in 8-hydroxy). Pushes toward 'region' tokens (steered output is 'Region regions region').

L27n372.name: 'Prom'/'orig' → 'Figure'
L27n372.description: Fires on word-opening fragments like 'Prom' (promising, prompts, prominent), 'orig' (origami) and 'Inf'. Pushes toward document-reference words 'Figure', 'Table', 'Section' (steered output is 'Figure Figure' or 'Table Table').

L27n237.name: Name-initial 'G' and 'th'
L27n237.description: Fires strongly negative on a lone capital initial that starts a person's surname (e.g. 'G' in 'Dennis G. Molinaro', 'Gellhorn', 'Gourdie') and on 'th' in thyme. Writes no clear token; steered output is blank whitespace.

L27n1418.name: Word-start fragments → punctuation
L27n1418.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word (e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'Gr' in gratitude, 'Al' in Almazaras, 'ind' in indigo). Pushes toward closing punctuation such as ')', ']' and quote marks (steered output degenerates into runs of '.*' or '.' punctuation).

L27n2399.name: Word-start capitals → '{{'
L27n2399.description: Fires on the first piece of a new term, often capitalized (e.g. 'Dis' in Dissecting and Disease, 'Inter' in Interstate, 'P' in Patches, 'Tr' in Trucks). Pushes toward opening brackets '{{', '[[', '((' (steered output is runs of '{{').

L27n1891.name: Pre-suffix stem, writes 'ind'
L27n1891.description: Fires strongly negative on mid-word stem pieces that a suffix follows (e.g. 'sil' in silhouettes, 'ox' in oxazolidinones, 'cl' in clindamycin, 'Wau' in Waukesha). Pushes toward 'ind' tokens (steered output is 'Indindind').

L27n2008.name: Stem before suffix fragment
L27n2008.description: The stem piece of a word split over several tokens, right before its suffix: 'apprec|iating', 'orig|ination', 'necess|itated', 'Spec|ified', 'accom|paniment'. Pushes toward short syllable fragments (PA, HA, GA, BA).

L27n1469.name: Mid-word and name pieces
L27n1469.description: Scattered mid-word subword pieces and name fragments (Environmental, Di|Prima, tropo|myosin, Con|ventional, Gy|orgy) with no single reading; pushes toward 'duration', 'longer', 'longest', and steered output spams 'longer'.

L27n1736.name: Split-off 'c' letter fragment
L27n1736.description: The letter 'c' or '-c' as a separate piece inside a split word: 'under|c|rust', 'radi|oc|arbon', 'photoc|atalytic', 'count|erc|lockwise', 'c|actus'. Pushes toward 'cur'.

L27n1668.name: Word-internal piece, writes enter
L27n1668.description: A non-initial piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'hem' in hemlock, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'mon' in monounsaturated, 'en' in Cenozoic. Pushes toward 'enter' and 'exit'.

L27n737.name: Word-fragment, writes female nouns
L27n737.description: A mid-word fragment that opens a longer word: 'cur' in curator, 'inv' in invigorating, 'izz' in frizzled, 'ru' in cruelty, 'mor' in morose. Pushes toward female nouns (women, girl, mother).

L27n1033.name: Piece before el ending
L27n1033.description: The fragment right before an 'el', 'ell' or 'els' ending: 'carp|els', 'kne|els', 'mack|erel', 'kn|ell', 'Fil|ad|elfia', 'bio|fu|els'. Pushes toward 'el'.

L27n1398.name: Word-start fragment, writes increase
L27n1398.description: The short first piece of a word split into tokens: 'sh' (shed, shampoos, shelve), 'Pl' (Plague, Platonist), 'Char' (Charlemagne), 'contr' (contraptions). Pushes toward 'increase' and 'increasing'.

L27n1938.name: Electronics word starts
L27n1938.description: Word-start pieces in hardware and display text, most often around LED, bl|ower motors, MAX7219 mat|rices and DSI displays; pushes toward 'driver' and 'drive' tokens, and steered output spams 'driver'.

L27n2247.name: Soil/manure nutrient context
L27n2247.description: Soil, manure and nutrient nouns, peaking on 'organic' (organic fertilizer, organic matter, organic waste), 'nitrogen' and 'sewage'. Pushes toward 'return'.

L27n985.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L27n985.description: The 'to' that opens an infinitive ('starts to bubble', 'tend to fall', 'needed to rest') and the 'who' before a bare verb, plus some 'bl' word starts; pushes toward 'store' tokens, and steered output spams 'store'.

L27n758.name: Size descriptor before noun
L27n758.description: A size or shape modifier before its noun: 'small nonstick', 'large bowl', 'heavy-bottomed sauce', 'cover crops', 'variable frequency drives'. Pushes toward dimension nouns (depth, height, length, width).

L27n1000.name: Early subword tri/di pieces
L27n1000.description: Early subword pieces of words, especially 'tri', 'di', 'dis', 'by' (Abyei), 'Wi' (Wi-Fi) and 'jou' (joules); pushes toward roman-numeral-like 'i', 'ii', 'iii' tokens, and steered output degenerates into 'iiii'.

L27n1308.name: Word-start re/rh fragment
L27n1308.description: The first piece of a split word, mostly 're', 'rh', 'Re' (rept-, rhe-umatic, Re-), also 'th', 'Le', 'Comp'. Pushes toward 'recovery', 'recover' and 'restore'.

L27n990.name: Word-start consonant fragment
L27n990.description: The initial piece of a multi-token word, often 'per', 'ch', 'conf', 'fl', 'ph' (perinatal, Chaco, confute, flinch, pharaoh). Pushes toward closing brackets ')', '}' and ']'.

L27n1447.name: sc/cr word starts
L27n1447.description: The 'sc', 'cr', 'kr' or 'Gr' piece opening a split word (sc|orpion, cr|abs, kr|ill, Sc|raping, Cr|ataegus); pushes toward '##' markdown headers, and steered output spams '###' and '##'.

L27n2814.name: Lone f, writes fill
L27n2814.description: A lone 'f' or 'F' piece that opens a word fragment: 'un|f|ounded', 'f|using', 'f|rozen', 'F|ocusing', '-f' in God-fearing. Pushes toward 'fill' and 'filled'.

L27n1850.name: pro word starts, project
L27n1850.description: The 'pro' or 'Pr' piece opening a word split into tokens (pro|portional, pro|vision, Pr|ize, Prop|ulsion); pushes toward 'project' and 'projects', and steered output spams 'project'.

L27n636.name: Proper-noun word pieces
L27n636.description: Early pieces of multi-token proper nouns and place or person names (Sats|uki, Gu|atem|alan, Nov|gorod, Han|umadh, Middles|brough, Pry|pyat); pushes toward 'uniform' and 'University' tokens, and steered output spams 'University'.

L27n2698.name: Letter v, writes volume
L27n2698.description: The letter 'v' or 'V' as a split piece: 'low-|voltage', 'current-to-|voltage', 'V|SDs', 'V|ital', 'v|oted'. Pushes toward 'volume' and 'Volume'.

L27n2794.name: Capitalized name fragment
L27n2794.description: The word-start fragment of a capitalized name or place: 'Pseudomonas put|ida', 'Mah|awkin', 'Sar|acen', 'Ne|olithic', 'Mi|ocene', 'Sav|anna'. Pushes toward 'depend' and 'dependency'.

L27n323.name: Uppercase word-start fragments
L27n323.description: Fires on a bare capital or 1-3 letter uppercase token that opens a word or name split across tokens, mostly in ALL-CAPS headings or after a capitalized name (the 'E' in 'OF E|CHINOCOCCUS', 'F' in 'Masato F|uruhashi'). Pushes toward uppercase word-continuation pieces like IC, DR, CE.

L27n2360.name: First split-word piece
L27n2360.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a longer word or name split across tokens, while the rest is still unseen ('n' in vicious-n|uns, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'recogn' in recogn|ising, 'Pots' in Pots|dam). Pushes toward 'nan' and 'nano' tokens.

L27n1705.name: Short word-start pieces
L27n1705.description: Fires on the short first piece ('cl', 'Int', 'Ind', 'Kh', 'Br', 'Ab') of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'grind and cl|enching', 'Wiley-Int|erscience', 'Kh|arkiv', 'Br|aunsbuttel'. Pushes toward 'approx' tokens.

L27n817.name: Capitalized name-part starts
L27n817.description: Fires on the token that opens a capitalized name or compound title ('La' in Ray LaHood, 'Ted' in Ted Stevens, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Dream' in Dreamliner, 'Water' in Water Lilies). Pushes toward single capital letters that start new names.

L27n2594.name: Cut-off opening fragments
L27n2594.description: Fires on a short word opener cut off mid-word: 'ref' in ref|ueling and ref|resher, 'tele' in tele|graph, 'fre' in fre|ighting, 'Tr' in Tr|ims, 'f' in f|errat. Pushes toward 'frame' tokens.

L27n610.name: Name-start fragments before quotes
L27n610.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized surname, place or title split across tokens ('M' in Macc|lesfield, 'P' in Pickett's, 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar, 'Stra' in Straits, 'K' in Kralove). Pushes toward closing quote and apostrophe marks.

L27n1828.name: Capital G/M word-starts
L27n1828.description: Fires on the first letter or two of a noun that opens a new word in a list or name context, most often a capital G or M (G|hetto, M|ites, G|OCI, H|ittite, M|ackerel). Pushes toward 'react' and 'reaction'.

L27n2280.name: Short hyphen-piece fragments
L27n2280.description: Fires on short subword pieces that start or continue a word in list-like or technical text: 'lie' in 'lie on the table', '-c' in 'single-celled' and 'foot-candle', 'line' in oxazolidinones, 'en' in Cenozoic. Pushes toward 'length'.

L27n2804.name: Sp word-start fragments
L27n2804.description: Fires on the 'sp' start of a word split into pieces, e.g. fast-|sp|reading, oil |Sp|ill, |Sp|inal, un|sp|ayed, |sp|elling. Pushes toward 'mill' and 'thousands'.

L27n1619.name: imm-/m- word starts
L27n1619.description: Fires on the 'imm' or 'Imm' piece opening immemorial, immune, immobility and immunities, and on bare 'm' starts such as mucus and mugs. Pushes toward 'mem' and 'memory' tokens.

L27n2628.name: Lone c in compounds
L27n2628.description: Fires on a lone 'c' or 'C' (or 'photoc') opening the second half of a hyphen or prefix compound: 'Anti-c|ancer', 'Self-c|leaning', 'single-c|elled', 'post-C|ivil', 'photoc|atalytic', '(c|liche)'. Pushes toward 'copy' tokens.

L27n1697.name: Technical name word starts
L27n1697.description: Fires on the first piece of a long technical or proper word split across tokens: 'Nec' in Nec|rolestes, 'pol' in pol|ycrystalline and pol|tergeist, 'Had' in Large Had|ron, '-aut' in semi-aut|onomous, 'rit' in embrit|tlement. Pushes toward 'degree' tokens.

L27n1826.name: Mid-word split fragments
L27n1826.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment in a split word, especially the second or third piece of a longer term (Min|st|rel, wil|debeest, omni|sc|ient, Przewal|zew|ski). Pushes toward 'rel'.

L27n26.name: System-prompt 'You are' openers
L27n26.description: Fires on the 'You' that opens the system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant'), on the 'assistant' that follows, and on instructive words in how-to text ('click any word', 'sign up', 'desktop or laptop'). Pushes toward rare nouns and story-like prose.

L27n1581.name: Cl/Col name starts
L27n1581.description: Fires on the first 'Cl', 'Col' or 'cl' piece of a capitalized name or word split across tokens ('Cl|ifton', 'Col|enso', 'cl|apping', 'cl|umps', 'Bl|anche'), and on '%' after an interest rate. Pushes toward 'gender', 'male' and 'female' tokens.

L27n1825.name: Lowercase split-word pieces
L27n1825.description: Fires on a short piece inside a split word with the word unfinished: 'gl' in glaucoma, 'Le' and 'le' in Leeks and lemons, 'ider' in epi|dermis, 'ely' in Th|elypteridaceae, 'med' in med|itate, 'ant' in ant|iretrovirals. Pushes toward 'psych' and 'psychological' tokens.

L27n818.name: Capitalized heading key term
L27n818.description: Fires on the capitalised key term inside a title or list heading, e.g. 'K' in 'Vitamin K Deficiency', 'Hunger' in 'Zero Hunger Initiative', 'Dirty' in 'Dirty Dozen', 'Lights' in 'UFO Lights'. Pushes toward 'Log' and 'Math' tokens.

L27n1034.name: s-start after prefix split
L27n1034.description: Fires on the 's' that opens the second half of a word after a hyphen or split: 'water-s|oluble', 'Water-S|oluble', 'quasi-s|culptural', 'nano-s|cale', 'susp|ensions', 'subs|ided'. Pushes toward 'sol' tokens such as solution and solve.

L27n2088.name: con-/enc- word openers
L27n2088.description: Fires on a 'con', 'enc' or 'spr' opener cut off mid-word: 'Self-con|cepts', 'post-con|sumer', 'pre-con|ceived', 'Enc|ourage', 'enc|roachment', 'spr|outs'. Pushes toward 'construction' and 'construct' tokens.

L27n2281.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L27n2281.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split name or word, such as 'Bod' in Bod|rum, 'Por' in Por|ifera, 'on' in Alon|zo H. Cushing, 'os' in cyn|os|ure, 'he' in Kas|he|fi, 'om' in chamom|ile. Pushes toward 'phone' and 'mobile' tokens.

L27n1467.name: Word-fragment, predicts 'label'
L27n1467.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into tokens (e.g. 're' in 'record labels', 'rec' in 'recollect', 'Rel' in 'Relational', 'dil' in 'dilates') and pushes the model to write 'label'/'labels'.

L27n2378.name: 'cr' word-start, pushes 'constraint'
L27n2378.description: Strongly negative on word-start 'cr'/'cre' fragments (e.g. 'cre' in crevice, 'cr' in crab and crannog, also 'mar' in Pietermaritzburg); pushing negative makes the model write 'constraint(s)'.

L27n805.name: First word of term
L27n805.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word term or proper name, before its head (e.g. 'Computer' in Computer Networks, 'Search' in Search Engine, 'Human' in Human Rights, 'Hiro' in Hiroshima); pushes capitalized word starts like 'St', 'Cl', 'Gr'.

L27n2354.name: Word-start fragments → 'remain'
L27n2354.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly Sup, Sal, San, Ex, Com (e.g. 'Sup' in Supposedly, 'Sal' in Salazar, 'Ex' in Excretory); pushes 'remain'/'remaining' tokens.

L27n1233.name: Predicts '-et' word ending
L27n1233.description: Fires on the piece of a word just before an '-et' ending (e.g. 'hou' in silhouette, 'pick' in picket, 'oplan' in exoplanet, 'epith' in epithet); pushes 'et'/'ets' tokens and makes the model spam 'et'.

L27n495.name: Mid-word fragments, pushes 'c'
L27n495.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'bus' in arbuscules, 'ly' in aminoglycosides, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'itory' in inhibitory); pushing negative makes the model write 'c' tokens.

L27n2622.name: 're' prefix, pushes 'receive'
L27n2622.description: Strongly negative on 're' fragments that start a word or a hyphen-joined prefix (e.g. 're' in reigned and reconstitution, '-re' in time-released); pushing negative makes the model write 'receive'/'received'.

L27n2382.name: 'S' word-start, pushes 'syn'
L27n2382.description: Fires on a lone capital or small 'S'/'sh' token that starts a word piece or follows a hyphen (e.g. '-S' in Pali-Sanskrit, 'silex', 'Siberia', 'sh' in shampoos); pushes 'syn'/'sync' tokens.

L27n207.name: 'a' before predicate adjective
L27n207.description: Strongly negative on the indefinite article 'a'/'an' (or 'can'/'have') opening a predicate in a chat answer, e.g. 'is a buzzword', 'is an essential', 'can have'; pushing negative makes the model spam quote and period tokens.

L27n1404.name: Hyphen 's', pushes 'size'
L27n1404.description: Fires on a lone 'S'/'s' piece after a hyphen or inside a word (e.g. '-S' in Full-Sized, '-S' in Mid-Senior, 'os' in nanoscale, 'uns' in unsatisfied); pushes 'size' tokens and makes the model spam 'size'.

L27n1681.name: Noun stems, pushes '|'
L27n1681.description: Strongly negative on the first fragment of a noun split into tokens (e.g. 'tur' in turkeys, 'sal' in salamanders, 'hil' in hillocks, 'catal' in catalase); pushing negative makes the model write '|' or '*' table and line markers.

L27n2447.name: Name-stem fragments, writes 'educ'
L27n2447.description: Strongly negative on the first fragment of a proper name split into tokens (e.g. 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'Borg' in Borglum, 'Tit' in Titus, 'Br' in Brunsbüttel); pushing negative makes the model write 'teach'/'educ' words.

L27n991.name: Medical stems, pushes 'per'
L27n991.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a long medical, chemical or food word split into tokens (e.g. 'hyp' in hypoparathyroidism, 'hydrogen', 'pol' in polystyrene, 'par' in parmesan, 'aim' in Nanaimo); pushes 'per' tokens.

L27n2501.name: Prefix 'pre'/'re' starts
L27n2501.description: Fires on the word-initial prefix piece 'pre', 'post' or 'Re' (e.g. 'pre' in preoccupied, 'pre-exposure', 'post' in post-Civil War, 'Re' in Recreational); pushes 'author' tokens.

L27n1300.name: 'You are' boilerplate, closers
L27n1300.description: Fires on 'are' in the boilerplate 'You are a helpful assistant' system prompt, and weakly on word starts like 'sc' in scallions; pushes closing brackets like ')' and '}'.

L27n1012.name: Mid-word chemical fragments, 'em'
L27n1012.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a long chemical or biological name split into tokens (e.g. 'anth' in chrysanthemum and astaxanthin, 'en' in carbapenems, 'ps' in sepsis, 'ret' in isotretinoin); pushes 'em'/'Em' tokens.

L27n759.name: Word-start fragments, closers
L27n759.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'exp' in expel, 'dec' in decoupled, 'cor' in corals, 'mar' in marveled, 'Th' in Thelypteridaceae); pushes closing brackets like '}' and ')'.

L27n2060.name: 'New'/'st' starts, 'issue'
L27n2060.description: Strongly negative on 'New' in place names (New Jersey, New York) and word-start fragments like 'st', 'spr' and 'Saint'; pushing negative makes the model write 'issue'/'issues'.

L27n17.name: Word stems, pushes suffixes
L27n17.description: Strongly negative on a word stem split from its ending (e.g. 'br' in tobramycin, 'trib' in tribus, 'ass' in assessor, 'inf' in infirm, 'var' in variances, 'contr' in contraption); pushing negative makes the model write suffixes like '-less', '-ant', '-ful', '-ably'.

L27n2343.name: Hyphen-joined 'N'/'re' pieces
L27n2343.description: Strongly negative on the 'N', 'n' or 're' that starts the second half of a hyphenated name or prefix (e.g. '-N' in Metro-North, 'Re' in Re-establishing, '-n' in non-natives, '-re' in self-reliance); pushing negative has a weak effect and nudges toward closing parens.

L27n2790.name: Split name fragments
L27n2790.description: The first short piece of a capitalized name or rare word that the tokenizer splits, e.g. 'Ne' in von Neumann, 'ep' in Lepsius, 'Fr' in Frisian, 'Ab' in Abi Dawud, 'ent' in entitles; pushes toward 'logic'.

L27n2700.name: Split name/word pieces
L27n2700.description: A first or middle piece of a name or word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Ker' in Keret, 'Hodg' in Hodgskin, 'Hog' in Hogarth, 'Yog' in Yogi, 'spr' in sprouted; pushes toward 'progress'.

L27n2140.name: Single S word starts
L27n2140.description: A one- or two-letter capital start piece, mostly 'S' opening a name (Saver, Sart, Sándor, Siberia) or a hyphen-s piece such as '-s' in quasi-sculptural, and 'os' in stereoscopy; pushes toward 'series'.

L27n550.name: Compound-word stems
L27n550.description: A combining stem whose compound word is still unfinished, e.g. 'Neuro' in neurotransmitters, 'Psycho' in psychotherapy, 'hydro' in hydrotestosterone, 'socio' in socio-spatial, 'poly' in polypropylene; pushes toward word endings 'et', 'ed', 'es'.

L27n2035.name: Re-/in- verb stems
L27n2035.description: Strongly negative on a word-initial stem fragment of a longer verb or noun, such as 'rec' in reciting or recaptured, 'reinc' in reincarnation, 'excav' in excavations, 'inc' in incision, and 'Prop' in propulsion. Pushes toward 'feature', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1395.name: Mid-word fragment splits
L27n1395.description: Fires on a short non-word fragment in the middle of a split word, such as 'erc' in clockwise, 'ic' in bactericidal, 'oc' in radiocarbon, 'sh' in shatter, and 'rd' in Córdoba. Pushes toward 'count/counts', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1423.name: Course and unit words
L27n1423.description: The word 'course' (esp. 'this course') and other lesson-structure nouns such as 'lesson', 'activity', 'object' in educational or training text, plus 'Po' and 'mal' word starts; pushes toward 'unit'.

L27n2892.name: Wildlife and hunting context
L27n2892.description: Animal and park words in wildlife or hunting text: 'National' in National Park, 'hunting', 'prey', 'wild', 'ungulates', 'gators', freshwater fish; pushes toward 'game'.

L27n1693.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1693.description: A letter-group piece inside an all-caps word or name, e.g. 'UL' in DINUZULU, 'IB' in LANGALIBALELE, 'DEV' in DEVIL'S, 'TR' in PROTRAV, 'ULAR' in MULTILOCULAR; pushes toward uppercase fragments like 'AD', 'AB', 'AC'.

L27n1772.name: Name-start word fragments
L27n1772.description: Mostly the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'S' in Sita, 'Co' in Coopworth, 'Hy' in Hygiene, 'Ja' in Jaén, 'T' in Tibbon, 'ye' in Yehuda; pushes toward 'maintain' and 'keep'.

L27n2064.name: Word inside compound term
L27n2064.description: Strongly negative on a word that is part of a multi-word term, before its head, such as 'Disease' in Disease Control, 'Pest' in Pest Control, 'content' in content management, and 'Mind' in MindMeister. Pushes toward 'management/manage', which it repeats when steered.

L27n472.name: bl- word onsets
L27n472.description: The 'bl' that opens a word split across tokens (blanch, blazes, blower, Blu-ray, blurring), plus a few other onsets such as 'bur' in burritos and 'emb' in embrittlement; pushes toward 'Get' and 'get'.

L27n1634.name: 'that' after a noun
L27n1634.description: The word right after a noun phrase that opens a clause, mostly 'that' before a verb (motifs that permeate, an event that triggers), and 'to', 'still', 'really' before a verb; pushes toward 'definition'.

L27n1109.name: Mid-word fragments
L27n1109.description: A middle piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'ahoo' in Chattahoochee, '-t' in tarred, '-p' in preserved, 'g' in gilded, 'ah' in docosahexaenoic, 'sur' in surges; pushes toward 'file'.

L27n3009.name: 'tr' word starts
L27n3009.description: Fires on a 'tr' or 'Tr' piece that starts a word, such as 'tr' in Gertrude, trapezoid, trinkets, and trams. Pushes toward 'operation/operations', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1284.name: Name fragments, surnames
L27n1284.description: Strongly negative on a name fragment, usually the first piece of a surname, such as 'Hos' in Hosfeld, 'Mol' in Molinaro, 'Her' in Herdwick, and 'chen' in Vlaschenko. Pushes toward 'find/finding', which it repeats when steered.

L27n585.name: Legal and court words
L27n585.description: Court and law words: 'Court' in Supreme Court, 'attorney' in attorney general, 'charges', 'accused', 'fee', 'FBI', and the word before a legal term such as 'right to'; pushes toward 'legal' and 'authorized'.

L27n803.name: Medical and place-name stems
L27n803.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into subtokens, often a medical or place-name stem, such as 'par' in parathyroid, parasympathetic, and parmesan, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'cl' in clindamycin, and 'pr' in prairie. Pushes toward 'value/values', which it repeats when steered.

L27n816.name: Proper-name starts, dotted initials
L27n816.description: Strongly negative on the capital letter that starts a proper name, such as 'U' in Uclés, 'Mon' in Monet, 'Jan' in Janeiro, 'Puerto' in Puerto Rico, and 'N' in Native. Pushes toward dotted initials like '.D', '.A', and '.M', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1154.name: Split 'in' and 're'
L27n1154.description: The 'in' inside Mackinac (strongest), the 're' prefix of reconnection, and 'st' starting stirs or stumbles, plus 'social' after a modifier; pushes toward 'connect'.

L27n2579.name: Sanskrit and name fragments
L27n2579.description: Fires on the middle piece of split foreign words and names, especially Sanskrit 'ś' and 'ṭ' or the 's' in Sita and Picual; pushes the '/' path-like token.

L27n2467.name: Word-start fragments (dermis, spay)
L27n2467.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'der' in dermis, 'sp' in spay, 'imp' in implicate; pushes 'term' and 'Term'.

L27n1881.name: Word-start fragment, 'comp'
L27n1881.description: Fires on the opening piece of a long or capitalized word split into tokens (Dim-, Gr-, Har-, Com-), strongest on the first piece; pushes 'comp' and 'com' continuations.

L27n2487.name: Mid-word fragments, 'wind'
L27n2487.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a word split into tokens (ict in Wydawnictwo, Gour- in Gourdie, Przew-als, Th- in thicken); pushes 'wind' and 'Tw'.

L27n380.name: Computing and tech names
L27n380.description: Fires inside software, OS and internet terms (Crypt- in cryptocurrency, Open- in OpenJDK, Fed- in Fedora, IPv in IPv2); pushes 'server' and 'Server'.

L27n2585.name: Proper-noun first token
L27n2585.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name, place or institution (En- in Enola Gay, Ob- in Obispo, Food in Food and Drug Administration); pushes 'ins' and 'INS'.

L27n1892.name: Word before 'box'
L27n1892.description: Fires on the word right before a likely 'box' (junction, sand, ticket, enclosed, fuse, lighting); pushes 'box' and 'boxes'.

L27n2201.name: 'and' in lists, 'command'
L27n2201.description: Fires on 'and' inside fatty-acid and oil lists and on the first part of fixed names (Air, Johan, Rolling); pushes 'command'.

L27n1238.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n1238.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often a consonant-cluster start (Cr-isps, Rh-inoceros, Gr-inds, Sl-), most at word start; pushes 'app' and 'App'.

L27n1673.name: Modifier before 'history'
L27n1673.description: Fires on the adjective or first noun of a two-word noun phrase whose head is still to come (labor, social, economic, natural, art); pushes 'history' and 'History'.

L27n1515.name: Split names, 'man'
L27n1515.description: Fires on the first part of a split name or term (Old, Middle, NEW, Ram-, Hodg-, german-), often in history and place text; pushes 'man' and 'Man'.

L27n1501.name: Split-name first piece
L27n1501.description: Fires on the first subword of a capitalized name or word (cre-vice, Bo-ats, Dol-aucothi, Ho-jiblanca), usually inside a list or name; pushes 'true' and 'false'.

L27n2653.name: Acronym and name starts
L27n2653.description: Fires on a token that starts an acronym or name piece (GC in GCSE, o in ophthalmologists, Dar in Dar es Salaam, Insurance in CHIP), mostly in education or insurance text; pushes 'credit' and 'alpha'.

L27n1342.name: Word before 'code'
L27n1342.description: Fires on the word right before 'code' (electrical, dress, tax, moral, criminal, genetic, licensing); pushes 'code' and 'codes'.

L27n1675.name: 'neut' before 'er'
L27n1675.description: Fires on the 'neut' piece of neuter or neutering in spay-neuter text, and on other word-start pieces; pushes the 'er' ending and 'Er'.

L27n1268.name: Capital letter starting nouns
L27n1268.description: Fires on a capital first letter that starts a name or list item (B in Bicycles, I in IAU, Z in Zaidi, South in South Africa); pushes 'city' and 'cities'.

L27n315.name: Word before quoted title
L27n315.description: Fires on connectives and naming words that introduce a quoted name or title (and, or, called, titled, entitled, saying); pushes closing quote and paren marks.

L27n886.name: Institution-name fragments
L27n886.description: Fires inside proper names of places and institutions (Jait-pur, Kh-ao, Budget Office, Security Agency, Monastery); pushes 'school', 'hospital', and 'institution'.

L27n65.name: Hyphen in compound words
L27n65.description: Fires on the hyphen, or an opening quote or paren, inside a compound (Non-qualified, Vehicle-to-vehicle, Notre-Dame, 'horny toad'); pushes code-style identifiers like 'Range' and 'Index'.

L27n1807.name: Word-start pieces, 'fast'
L27n1807.description: Fires on the 'as' in 'such as' and on the first piece of split names (Cal-iphate, Abdul, Min-aret, Ro-che); pushes speed words 'fast', 'quick', and 'rapid'.

L27n1218.name: Mid-name word fragments
L27n1218.description: Fires (negative) on a word-internal piece of a split name or compound, e.g. 'Dum|fries', 'Daw|es', 'von Ne|umann', 'Tri|beca'; pushes toward 'activity', 'outputs' and 'inputs'.

L27n2521.name: Word-initial h fragment
L27n2521.description: Fires (negative) on a lone 'h' or 'H' that opens a word split into pieces ('Rh' in rhinoceros, 'h' in hump, hilly, Hips); pushes toward 'factor'-type nouns.

L27n2159.name: Prefix pieces inter/sub
L27n2159.description: Fires (negative) on a prefix token such as 'inter', 'sub', 'trans' or 'in' that begins a longer word split into pieces (interventional, subcutaneous, transmissible); pushes toward '#' hash and heading tokens.

L27n1196.name: Digit inside a number
L27n1196.description: Fires (negative) on a single digit inside a multi-digit number, mostly the later digits of years and quantities (the '8' in -286, the '2' in 1920s, the '0' in 300°F); pushes toward more digits.

L27n2428.name: Non-/anti- prefix pieces
L27n2428.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split at a prefix or hyphen ('nond|iscriminatory', 'anti-d|rying', 'self-d|etermination', 'Ga|stric'); pushes toward 'draw' and 'drawing'.

L27n2980.name: st/St word onsets
L27n2980.description: Fires (positive) on 'st' or 'St' opening a word split into pieces ('st|are', 'St|abilizes', 'pre-st|ressed'); pushes toward Android code tokens such as 'android', 'Intent' and 'MainActivity'.

L27n1035.name: Word-start fragments rem/som
L27n1035.description: Fires (positive) on a short fragment that begins a split word, strongest on 'rem' (remodeled, remembrance), 'som' (somersaults), 'imm' and 'sh' (headshaking); pushes toward 'variables', 'fields' and 'parameters'.

L27n2748.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n2748.description: Fires (positive) on a word-opening consonant cluster split into its own token ('cr' in crannog, 'br' in bruxism, 'chr' in Cenchrus, 'Th' in thinning); pushes toward 'exam' and 'examiner'.

L27n1503.name: Academic field stems
L27n1503.description: Fires (positive) on the stem just before a subject or role noun, strongest on 'theolog' (theologians), 'scient', 'mathematic', 'photoc' and 'phon'; pushes toward subject names like 'chemistry', 'geometry', 'biology' and 'physics'.

L27n1367.name: Proper-name fragments Dor/Har
L27n1367.description: Fires (positive) on the first piece of a split proper name or place ('Dor|set', 'Har|binder', 'Har|riette', 'gu|ineensis'); pushes toward 'input' and 'inputs'.

L27n1667.name: Word-start p/pl/d pieces
L27n1667.description: Fires (positive) on a one- or two-letter piece that starts a word split into tokens ('snow|pl|ow', 'd|ries', 'p|ungent', 'und|ies', 'Char|lemagne'); pushes toward 'describe' and 'description'.

L27n1694.name: Mid-word stem fragments
L27n1694.description: Fires (negative) on a mid-word piece that starts a longer stem ('append|icitis', 'pred|iabetes', 'Rod|inia', 'Ind|ex'); pushes toward 'del' and 'Del'.

L27n827.name: Water, than, dis fragments
L27n827.description: Fires (positive) on 'water', on 'than' after 'equal or greater' in antibiotic thresholds, and on split pieces like 'undis|covered', '-dis|covery' and 'ozy' in heterozygous; pushes toward 'log' and 'logs'.

L27n428.name: Parenthesis and citation openers
L27n428.description: Fires (positive) on an opening '(' before a name, or on the first token of a date, citation or phonetic bracket ('(Litchi', '(Boydston', 'Mar. 1'); pushes toward digits.

L27n814.name: Prepositions before noun phrases
L27n814.description: Fires (positive) on 'in', 'through' or 'and' right after a verb or noun and before a named setting or noun phrase ('in Kubernetes', 'in New Zealand', 'through our skin'); pushes toward 'idea', 'option' and 'choice'.

L27n1451.name: Past-participle verb stems
L27n1451.description: Fires (negative) on the opening piece of a past-participle verb after has, was or be, split into tokens ('rec|eded', 'dec|imated', 'inf|ested', 'c|logged', 'ro|amed'); pushes toward 'reduced', 'improved' and 'increased'.

L27n2069.name: squ/pur/bl word onsets
L27n2069.description: Fires (positive) on a split word opening with 'squ', 'pur', 'bl' or 'sl' ('squ|irts', 'squ|ishing', 'pur|ulent', 'sl|ams'); pushes toward 'press' and 'pressure'.

L27n2775.name: N-start and kne fragments
L27n2775.description: Fires (negative) on a capital 'N' or on fragments like 'kne' (knead), 'Des' and 'Desc' (Desert, Descend) that start a split name or word; pushes toward 'tool' and 'tools'.

L27n539.name: Hispanic names and places
L27n539.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a name or place in Hispanic-region text ('Jo|aquin' in San Luis Obispo, 'Ram|bla' in Barcelona, 'Aj|zen'); pushes toward nationality adjectives like 'Spanish', 'Brazilian' and 'Mexican'.

L27n1605.name: Place/people name pieces
L27n1605.description: Fires (positive) on the first or middle piece of a place or people name ('A|gra', 'Tar|quin', 'Vas|ude|va', 'Chug|oku', 'Ulu' in KwaZulu); pushes toward nationality adjectives like 'African', 'Egyptian' and 'Irish'.

L27n1452.name: Split-word F fragment
L27n1452.description: Fires on a capital 'F' that opens a word or name split into tokens (Faisal, Festival, Ferry, Fauvism), mid-sentence. Pushes the model toward opening brackets '(' and '['.

L27n1663.name: Animal-word first fragment
L27n1663.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, mostly 'rh' in rhino and 'fl' in flax or flares, plus 'Hel' in helicopters. Effect pushes toward 'str' tokens, which do not match the reads.

L27n1438.name: Ancient Greek/Roman names
L27n1438.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split proper noun in ancient-history text (Rom|mel, Prot|olaurasia, Sal|amis, Ang|ara). Pushes toward 'Greek', 'Roman' and 'Greece'.

L27n2684.name: Split-name fragments toward immune
L27n2684.description: Fires on early pieces of split names and words (Br|igid, Bl|asco, sarc|ophagi). Pushes toward 'immun' tokens (immune, immunity), which the reads do not explain.

L27n3034.name: Split technical-word fragments
L27n3034.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of split technical or literary words (sarc|ophagi, st|roma, the 'BA' of an AABA rhyme, cry|stalline). Effect pushes toward 'str' and 'Low'.

L27n664.name: Diffuse title-case labels
L27n664.description: Goes strongly negative on diffuse title-case words in headings and labels (Song, Infrastructure, Flower, Game) and on sentence-end periods. Writes adjectives such as 'Low', 'Common' and 'Big', but the effect is weak.

L27n1913.name: Stem before -graphy
L27n1913.description: Fires on the stem piece just before '-graphy' in split imaging terms (tom|ography, electromy|ography, neutron-computed tomography). Pushes toward 'graph' tokens.

L27n2224.name: Later split-word pieces
L27n2224.description: Fires on later subword pieces of long words (ep|ider|mis, der|mis, inter|connect, fer|mentation, stere|otyping). Pushes toward 'na' and 'ní' fragments, which do not match the reads.

L27n1640.name: Capital letter opening names
L27n1640.description: Fires on a single capital letter or short first piece that opens a split proper name or term (C in Caao, K in Kitten, Wol in Wolpertingers), mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'direction' tokens.

L27n256.name: Token closing parenthetical acronym
L27n256.description: Fires on the last letter or number inside parentheses just before the closing ')' in acronyms and codes (CK[D], K-1[2], U.K.). Pushes toward commas right after the closing parenthesis.

L27n592.name: Medical condition terms
L27n592.description: Goes strongly negative on disease, condition and symptom words (blood clots, hematoma, chronic asthma, deficiency, circulation problems). Pushes toward 'error' and 'disease' tokens.

L27n1941.name: Acronym and name fragments
L27n1941.description: Fires on the second piece of split words and acronym tails (hypo|od|erm|is, the D in DHA, Borg|lum, Mis|informed). Pushes toward 'system' and 'girls' or 'boys' tokens.

L27n2998.name: Split word-opening pieces
L27n2998.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word or name that the next token completes (Pal|amedes, Ad|en, cho|lesterol, Pic|ual). Pushes toward 'student' tokens.

L27n136.name: Mid-name capitals, citation tails
L27n136.description: Fires on capital letters and short pieces inside long proper names (Ruzvo, Rzewuski, M|ek ong) and on the last token of a DOI. Pushes toward sentence-final punctuation.

L27n336.name: Finance and money context
L27n336.description: Goes strongly negative in finance and banking text, on words like 'of' in 'cost of good sale' or 'amount of deposits', 'reserve at' and 'an increase'. Pushes toward 'financial' and 'money'.

L27n595.name: URL and path tails
L27n595.description: Goes strongly negative on domain and URL tails (.com, .jp, sciencedaily.com/releases/...), and on numeric fragments inside URLs and formulas. Pushes toward '/' path tokens.

L27n1546.name: Capital C word starts
L27n1546.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'C' or 'c' that starts a split term (C|iel, c|AMP, C|oupole, c|innamon). Effect pushes toward 'response' tokens, which the reads do not explain.

L27n1823.name: Upper/lower level words
L27n1823.description: Fires on 'upper', 'of', 'over' and 'Ming' inside phrases of rank or level (upper limit, Upper Macedonia, Ming Dynasty), mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'middle' and 'mid'.

L27n1465.name: Rel- and very-least words
L27n1465.description: Fires on the first piece of split words (rel|ays, rel|iance, electro|static) and on 'very' in 'at the very least'. Pushes toward 'less' and 'least'.

L27n1961.name: Ornate material adjectives
L27n1961.description: Fires on descriptive material and ornament words in product or building text (Gothic, Decorated, gilded, Leather, Bronze, glittery) and on split pieces like spl|ints. Pushes toward 'detail' tokens.

L27n2085.name: Capital-G fragments → Italian
L27n2085.description: The 'G' piece of a word split into tokens (Gundisapur, G-d, Gospels, Ghetto) plus other mid-word fragments; pushes the model toward 'Italian/Italy' and other European country names.

L27n1934.name: Word fragments → 'sample'
L27n1934.description: A short piece inside a split word (wh in whiff, min in minima, Pr in Priscus, bro in brood, sc in screech); pushes the model toward 'sample/samples'.

L27n2237.name: St/le starts → leaf
L27n2237.description: The short opening piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'St'/'st' (Stems, stearic, stanzas) and 'le' (lemons, lethal); pushes toward 'leaf/leaves'.

L27n703.name: Name-start fragments → dots
L27n703.description: The first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (Kh in Kharkiv, Pr in Prussian, Ant in António, Sch in Schizaeaceae, K in Kourou); pushes toward '.' and other punctuation after an identifier.

L27n1635.name: Mid-word fragments → field
L27n1635.description: A later piece of a word split across tokens (aim in Nanaimo, Ble in Bleach, iti in Citi, ly in Ulysses); pushes toward 'field/fields'.

L27n3064.name: P/wh starts → emergency
L27n3064.description: The opening piece of a word, mostly 'P' (Palla, Pavan), 'wh' (whetstone, whiff) and '-st' (-stressed); pushes toward 'emergency', 'crisis' and 'rescue'.

L27n1441.name: p/squ starts → x
L27n1441.description: The opening piece of words beginning with p, squ or scr (Patches, squirts, scraping, hyp- in hypoparathyroidism); pushes toward 'x' as in a variable.

L27n623.name: Long-word fragments → quality
L27n623.description: A piece of a long word split into tokens (Stra in Straits, pow in powdery, Therm in Thermopylae, Gen in Genoa, ou in cantaloupe); pushes toward 'quality', 'safety' and 'accuracy'.

L27n1009.name: ALL-CAPS → caps pieces
L27n1009.description: Uppercase word-pieces inside ALL-CAPS text (D in DETERMINE, ING in SELF-HARMING, INESS in BUSINESS); pushes toward uppercase fragments such as 'SAM', 'CAM' and 'SPA'.

L27n839.name: Mid-word fragments → 'en'
L27n839.description: The middle piece of a word split into tokens (cl in clenching, ark in harkened, qu in quell, wors in worsens, euth in euthanized); pushes toward 'en' and 'En'.

L27n1570.name: gl/-p starts → instrument
L27n1570.description: The opening piece of a word split into tokens in technical nouns (gl in gliders and glazes, -p in twisted-pair, Dor in Dorset); pushes toward 'instrument(s)' and 'equipment'.

L27n2341.name: Capital starts → void
L27n2341.description: The first one or two letters of a word split into tokens, often capitalized (Ad in Aden, De in Deportation, Ne in Neutrophils, ob in obliterating); pushes toward 'void'.

L27n1657.name: Split-word pieces → mark
L27n1657.description: Assorted pieces in the middle of split words (lem in Radiotelemetric, fold in fold-out, roph in acrophobia, Jur in Jurisdiction); pushes toward 'mark/marks'.

L27n1560.name: Words before 'service'
L27n1560.description: The word just before an expected 'service' (Civil, Statistical, Wildlife, dis in disservice, Geological); pushes the model toward 'service/Service'.

L27n273.name: Mid-word fragments → ane
L27n273.description: Middle pieces of split words (ARR in PARRISE, iox in Vortioxetine, nit in nitrate, Nec in Necrolestes, Kh in Khamba); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ane', 'ice' and 'ave', and steered text drifts into 'cave'.

L27n2437.name: Compound starts → media
L27n2437.description: The opening piece of a longer word split into tokens (IMM in IMMEDIATE, multim in multimedia, rem in remembrance, renom in adrenomimetic); pushes toward 'media' and 'med'.

L27n2257.name: P starts → system
L27n2257.description: A lone 'P' or 'p' that opens a word split into tokens (Punctuality, Pisa, Puzzles, pious, -published); pushes toward 'system/systems'.

L27n1643.name: p/sp starts → paper
L27n1643.description: A 'p' or 'sp' that opens a word piece (Spallation, spurious, pungent, -pip.py, potash); pushes toward 'paper/papers'.

L27n1242.name: Object nouns before case
L27n1242.description: A household object noun that often comes right before 'case' (pillow, pencil, glass, display, cigarette, toothbrush); pushes toward 'case/cases'.

L27n1130.name: en starts → American
