L27n1130.description: The opening piece 'en' (enlisting, enforces, enshrined) and some other word starts such as 'Ost', 'stre' and 'Old'; pushes toward 'American/Americans'.

L27n1473.name: Split-word fragment, -ar ending
L27n1473.description: The mid-word piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'spe' or 'she' before 'ars' (asparagus spears, shears); also 'Oh'|'ad' and 'metam'|'orph'. Pushes toward '-are', '-ary' and '-ern' suffix tokens.

L27n557.name: Name fragment, computer output
L27n557.description: The middle piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Mos'|'he', 'Qut'|'b', 'Gut'|'enmacher', 'Mir'|'ai'), plus some chat-prompt words. Pushes toward 'computer' and 'digital' tokens.

L27n2077.name: Long-word middle piece
L27n2077.description: The second or middle token of a long technical word split into pieces ('aqu'|'ac'|'ulture', 'par'|'ap'|'legia', 'Ge'|'ob'|'acter', 'cephal'|'op'|'od'). Pushes toward 'l'-initial tokens such as 'l', 'lan' and 'lat'.

L27n995.name: Soil and earth topics
L27n995.description: Content words for land and nature: soil erosion, coral, olive varieties, the ozone layer, vegetation. Fires on the noun naming the land or environmental thing. Pushes toward 'soil', 'earth' and 'vegetation' tokens.

L27n1413.name: Oven temps, mixed prose
L27n1413.description: The last digit of an oven temperature or calorie count ('40|0°F', '190|4 calories'), plus 'the' or 'at' in mixed prose. Activation is diffuse and low. Pushes toward 'big' tokens.

L27n2615.name: Token before 'science'
L27n2615.description: The word just before 'science' or 'scientific' ('rocket', 'political', 'citizen-sc', 'Inters|c|ience'), so it fires on the lead-in piece rather than the word itself. Pushes toward 'science' and 'scientist' tokens.

L27n1893.name: Word-start 'ch' or 'G'
L27n1893.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'ch' ('ch|ameleons', 'ch|elator') or a capital 'G' opening a name ('G|ospels', 'G|utzon'). Pushes toward 'play' tokens.

L27n1989.name: Word-start 'sp' or 'p'
L27n1989.description: The 'sp' or lone 'p' that opens a word split into tokens ('sp|ayed', 'sp|ears', 'sp|ines', 'p|atted', 'p|iled'). Pushes toward 'share' tokens.

L27n279.name: Split-name middle piece
L27n279.description: The piece right after the opening of a split proper name or rare word ('Schw|ann', 'Dev|onta', 'Mill|an', 'Ash|on', 'Brow|ning'). Pushes toward German-like '-nden' and '-nan' endings.

L27n632.name: Opening punctuation before aside
L27n632.description: An opening mark that starts an aside or definition: '(' after a term, an opening quote, a dash or hyphen before the next clause ('macrolides (', 'the tear film' quote). Pushes toward '-ting' and '-ted' suffix tokens.

L27n1984.name: Word-opening letter H
L27n1984.description: The letter H or h that starts a word or a piece after a hyphen ('self-H|ARMING', 'h|arvesting', 'H|addal', 'h|edges'). Pushes toward 'http' and 'https' tokens.

L27n2556.name: Pre-completion word fragment
L27n2556.description: The piece just before a word or name finishes ('str|icken', 'snow|plow', 'Dead|wood', 'Koh|li', 'Beng|a'), often the stem of a split word. Pushes toward first names such as 'Bob', 'Tom', 'Alice' and 'Joe'.

L27n383.name: Mid-word piece, then B
L27n383.description: A piece inside a long word or name split into tokens ('neph|ro|logy', 'avers|ine', 'chol|era', 'retro|virus'). Pushes toward capital 'B' tokens.

L27n39.name: Opening quote mark
L27n39.description: The opening quotation mark (“, ‘ or a straight quote) that starts a quoted title, phrase or speech, or a dash before a clause. Pushes toward unrelated tokens such as 'Ikea', 'blat' and 'woodshallaby'.

L27n1317.name: Modifier before category noun
L27n1317.description: The adjective or word stem directly before a head noun, e.g. 'popular' before cryptocurrencies, 'limiting' before gender stereotypes, 'rolling' before elements. Pushes toward 'classes', 'class', 'areas' and 'sectors'.

L27n2151.name: Word-start 'sp' or 'p'
L27n2151.description: The 'sp' or 'p' that opens a word split into tokens ('sp|iced', 'p|atty', 'P|isa', 'sp|illing'), usually at the start of a word. Pushes toward 'shape' tokens.

L27n178.name: Split-name second piece
L27n178.description: The second piece of a split proper name or place ('Kub|ayi', 'Sk|op|je', 'Re|enen', 'Luk|in', 'Te|es'). Pushes toward 'e'-syllable tokens such as 'eren', 'elle' and 'emet'.

L27n2527.name: Start of proper name
L27n2527.description: The first piece of a proper name, place or person ('Lake' in Lake Erie, 'Ban|ff', 'Ost|ia', 'Dim|ocarpus', 'Zheng' He). Pushes toward 'effect' and 'effects' tokens.

L27n203.name: Mid-word piece, a syllable
L27n203.description: A piece in the middle of a split word or name ('Sothe|bys', 'whisk|ers', 'Da|ughters', 'Kos|rae'), where the next piece completes it. Pushes toward 'a'-syllable tokens such as 'aman', 'atan' and 'aga'.

L27n37.name: Inside a fixed title
L27n37.description: The word inside a fixed multi-word title or institution, e.g. 'Christian Science' Monitor, 'Affordable Care' Act, 'Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security' Agency, 'one-of-a-kind'. Pushes toward em-dash '—' tokens.

L27n1827.name: Split technical-term fragments
L27n1827.description: Fires on a mid-word sub-token of a technical or scientific term split into pieces (Ps in Psittacula, co in coagulation, infra in infra-red, ke in keV, ionic conduction), and on 'blood' in medical lists. Pushes toward 'red/Red'.

L27n135.name: Capitalized name onsets
L27n135.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or token of a capitalized name or title mid-sentence (L in Lotto, S in Sutak, C in CARS, B in Bower, F in Fahrenheit), and on clause-opening 'so'. Pushes toward word-fragment continuations (aps, uff, ild, udge), giving garbled output.

L27n1164.name: Set-phrase verbs, -M fragments
L27n1164.description: Goes negative on the verb or preposition in set phrases (come into force, take over, take action, reach conclusions, first line of defense) and on capital-M fragments in names (-M in Wisconsin-Madison, Saif-ul-Maluk). Pushes toward '-al' adjectives (mathematical, financial, economic).

L27n2545.name: ALL-CAPS word onsets
L27n2545.description: Fires on the first piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (BUSINESS WIRE, LIMITED APPROACH, OTHER SETS, SELLER, DEVIL'S, EXT. ART), and on word-stem pieces like 'underst' in understudied. Pushes toward uppercase HTTP verbs (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE).

L27n2831.name: P/p word starts; 'listening'
L27n2831.description: Fires on a word-initial 'P' or 'p' or 'ep' piece (PESTICIDES, Pots, Puzzles, pentaBDE, epidermis), including split-off pieces; pushes 'listening', 'hearing', 'reading', spamming 'hearing' when steered.

L27n1004.name: Word-internal fragments
L27n1004.description: Fires on a fragment inside a longer word or name (hip in hippos, cal in calici-, vis in cerevisiae, ely in Thelypteridaceae, isc in Priscus), and on a few plain words after a preposition ('direct fan', 'head start', 'higher efficiency'). Pushes toward 'start/starting'.

L27n335.name: Capitalized noun-head onsets
L27n335.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun head (Bo in Boer, B in B-29, O in OER, Vil in Vilas, V in V2 rockets), and on nouns like water, ozone and taste (waterways, ozone layer, taste buds). Pushes toward generic data-structure nouns (matrix, network, tree, table, array).

L27n442.name: Split-word opening syllables
L27n442.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a split word or name (ost in mangosteen, Koh in Kohli, fl in sulfoxaflor and fluff, ref in refueling, Inf in Infinitives, wan in Kwanzaa, F in Fruit). Pushes toward short syllable fragments (uru, ulu, LU, BU), which produce nonsense.

L27n533.name: Split words, generic nouns
L27n533.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (mul in mulch, col in colander, cant in cantaloupe, aut in autocrat, atal in catalytic), and on a word right before a generic noun (open-source, search box, good look). Pushes toward generic nouns: service, program, algorithm, method, project.

L27n838.name: Capitalized H/B/T onsets
L27n838.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or word, mostly H, Har, B, T, Th, Ar or Sh (Harbinder, Haven't, Babylon, Talmud, Tibbon, Arnett). Pushes toward exclamation marks.

L27n983.name: 'self' in compounds
L27n983.description: Goes negative on 'self' as a prefix or standalone word (self-harm, Self-compassion, self-reported, NOTE TO SELF), plus 'IS' in 'TEENAGER IS SELF-HARMING'; pushes the token 'self', spamming it when steered.

L27n2053.name: Word-start pieces; 'target' writer
L27n2053.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare or split word, usually a consonant start (Th|espians, Tit|us, C|igarette, sw|amps, lact|ose, Kh|arkiv, ret|inoin); pushes 'target' and 'targets', spamming 'target' when steered.

L27n1504.name: Name-start P; comma lists
L27n1504.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a name or noun (P in Polar bear and Pumsaint, Nap|ster, Ap|ocrypha, hypoth|alamus) and on commas in noun lists (Videos, worksheets, games); pushes 'lines', 'rows', 'eyes', spamming 'lines' when steered.

L27n2678.name: 'f' word-starts; 'old' writer
L27n2678.description: Goes negative on a lone 'f' that opens a word or follows a hyphen (trans-fatty, three-forked, f|loss, f|leas, f|umes, f|amily); pushes 'old' and 'Old', which spam when steered.

L27n584.name: Aux/prep words; onset writer
L27n584.description: Goes negative on auxiliaries and prepositions that lead into a verb or noun (will, after, being, ’t, are) and on nouns like tin, tree, oil; pushes two-letter consonant onsets (pl, fl, cl, sp, tr, gr), which garble text when steered.

L27n2213.name: Name word onsets
L27n2213.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or compound (Ub in Graubünden, Z in Zatorre, Eug in Eugen, Sh in Shiloh, Mu in Muir Beach, Ch in Chaco, sm in smog, ch in chowders). Pushes toward 'meet/meeting'.

L27n1463.name: Punctuation before parentheses
L27n1463.description: Fires on punctuation that opens a parenthesis or joins a compound: '-' in protect-your and ill-posedness, '(' in (AIDS) and (Musical, '=' in F=∂A and x=0, '/' in Consumer/Event. Weak effect; pushes toward capital abbreviation starts (SU, LB, SF, DH).

L27n635.name: Capital P, IPA symbols
L27n635.description: Fires on a capital 'P' starting a word (Patches, Potters, Packed, Pies, Pustules), on the digit after the copyright sign in years (2 in 2005), and on IPA stress and vowel symbols (ˈ, ɪ, ə). Pushes toward asterisk and symbol tokens (*, %, @, &).

L27n1565.name: 'cr' word-starts; 'man' writer
L27n1565.description: Goes negative on the 'cr' or 'cro' start of a split word, mostly animals (cr|abs, cr|anes, cr|ickets, cro|codiles), and on 'agr', 'Pest', 'ple' starts; pushes 'man', 'Man', 'mans', spamming 'man' when steered.

L27n1122.name: Water nouns, was/been
L27n1122.description: Goes negative on water and kitchen-type nouns (Sea in Sea Berry, water in waterways and groundwater, kitchen table, lawn, limestone), and on 'was' or 'been' before a passive verb (was originally presented, have been abandoned). Pushes toward 'table/tables'.

L27n1562.name: Word-start 'f' fragment
L27n1562.description: Fires on 'f' or 'F' opening the second piece of a split word (fold|ing, fam|ily, fa|ble, F|ossil), plus a few other short word-start pieces. Pushes 'previous' and 'prev' tokens, which the reads do not explain.

L27n1140.name: Word-start 'sh' and 'role'
L27n1140.description: Fires on 'sh' opening a second piece (mis|shapen, molt|shed) and on 'role' before 'models' or 'plays'. Pushes 'model' and 'models' tokens.

L27n2433.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n2433.description: Fires on short consonant-cluster word starts that open a split word, mostly 'cl', 'gl', 'br' (cl|apping, gl|iders, br|uxism, br|ain). Pushes 'user' and 'User' tokens with no clear link to what it reads.

L27n873.name: Stem before 'in' ending
L27n873.description: Fires on the piece just before an 'in' ending inside split names (oxy|toc|in, isot|ret|in, Bed|ou|in, Bak|un|in, Alame|in, somat|ost|atin). Pushes 'in' and 'In' tokens, and steered output spams 'in'.

L27n1849.name: 'cons' prefix of 'consider'
L27n1849.description: Fires on 'cons', 'Con' or 'P' starting a split word (cons|cription, cons|istent, Con|ception), most strongly on 'cons'. Pushes 'consider' tokens, and steered output spams 'Consider'.

L27n2205.name: Word-start 'st' / 'sh'
L27n2205.description: Fires on 'st', 'sh' or 'Ant' starting a split word (st|umble, st|ew, sh|rouded, Ant|idote, reint|roduced). Pushes 'introduction' and 'introduce' tokens, which the reads do not match, so the pairing is weak.

L27n682.name: Capital token in names
L27n682.description: Fires on capitalised or code tokens inside names, acronyms and sudo rules (ALL=(ALL), American Animal Hospital, Köppen Aw, Neuchâtel). Pushes '=' followed by a capital letter ('=E', '=C', '=False'); steered answers stay coherent.

L27n1027.name: Stem before 'u' continuation
L27n1027.description: Fires on the stem piece just before a 'u' continuation inside a split word (est|uaries, congr|uence, confl|uent, purs|ues, sanct|uaries, discontin|uity). Pushes 'u' tokens; steered output is 'u u u' spam.

L27n1215.name: Word before noun
L27n1215.description: Fires on the word or piece right before the noun it modifies (mult|ilocularis, volt|ages, spinal cord, drinking water, bladder, and 'a' in 'come to a head'). Pushes 'head' and 'heads' tokens; steered output spams 'head'.

L27n1155.name: Single consonant word start
L27n1155.description: Fires on a one-letter or consonant word start that opens a split word (C|attle, C|igarette, V|itamins, g|ators, b|oulders, Pag|len). Pushes pronouns 'He', 'His', 'he' and 'him'.

L27n923.name: Mid-word stem before suffix
L27n923.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before a suffix (fasc|iitis, ovolta|ic, forfe|it, retal|iate, per|nicious, Euras|ian). Pushes suffix pieces such as 'ity', 'ik', 'ib' and 'ié'.

L27n1055.name: Word-start fragment; fi/fl
L27n1055.description: Fires on short word-start pieces of split words (di|hydrotestosterone, idi|abetic, Pro|phethood, intr|uding, ste|amer, self-de|emed). Pushes 'ﬂ' and 'ﬁ' ligature tokens; steered output is whitespace and newline spam.

L27n1669.name: Stem before '-us' ending
L27n1669.description: Fires on the piece just before a '-us' ending in Latin or Greek names (Lin|us, Tit|us, lot|us, Caucas|us, Lazar|us, philadelph|us). Pushes 'us' and 'US' tokens; steered output is 'usus' spam.

L27n195.name: Hyphen or parenthesis
L27n195.description: Fires on '(' or '-' that opens an example list or joins a compound (macrolides (erythromycin, two-dose, de-odorizing, 16-lead). Pushes 'ful' and 'fully' suffix tokens; steered output spams 'ful'.

L27n421.name: Word in multi-word name
L27n421.description: Fires on a word completing a multi-word proper name or title (Educational in Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, Middle in Middle East, Health in World Health Organization). Pushes 'region', 'area', 'context' and 'environment', a weak link.

L27n1373.name: Sentence-end punctuation before newline
L27n1373.description: Fires on sentence- or line-ending punctuation, especially '.', ':', '!' or ')' right before a line break or code block. Pushes closing-quote and code-string tokens; steered output spams quote marks.

L27n2054.name: Name fragment; 'law' write
L27n2054.description: Fires on the middle piece of split proper names and words (sl|aw, carn|ivorans, juris|prudence, uncon|sciously, Nan|jing, Ban|ff, Beng|uela). Pushes 'law', 'Law' and 'legal'; steered output is 'Law law' spam.

L27n432.name: Capital start of name
L27n432.description: Fires on the capitalised first piece of a split proper name (Br|ueseh, Bl|asco, Br|unsbüttel, Ish|iguro). Pushes bullet and separator symbols '·', '•', '||', '»' and '##'; steered output is a row of dots.

L27n1069.name: Technical word fragments; 'type'
L27n1069.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of technical or medical terms (catal|ase, hydro|xy|deoxyguanosine, cerv|isiae, ble|ached, per|itoneal). Pushes 'type' and 'Type' tokens; steered output is 'type type' spam.

L27n638.name: Capitalised name opener
L27n638.description: Fires on the capital letter or short piece that opens a proper name or acronym split across tokens (Z|aidi, U|ML, A|verroes). Pushes field nouns 'theory', 'culture' and 'technology'; steered output is 'culture culture' spam.

L27n1710.name: Name and word fragments
L27n1710.description: The middle piece of a name or long word split into tokens (ro in bullfrogs, iy in Ikhtiyar), pushing 'proof' or 'evidence' next.

L27n2564.name: Split-name pieces, LaTeX breaks
L27n2564.description: The mid-word piece of a split name or word (Cro in Croesus, ame in Alamein), pushing LaTeX line-break tokens.

L27n2468.name: Name pieces, 'global'
L27n2468.description: The second piece of a split name or word (Carnegie, allow, the 'um' in Mpumalanga), pushing 'global'.

L27n756.name: 'You' opening system prompts
L27n756.description: The word 'You' that opens a chat system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant'), pushing 'have' or 'has' next.

L27n998.name: Negative: split-word middles
L27n998.description: Fires strongly negative on the middle piece of a split name or word (Coll in Collins, Platan in Platanus, And in Andalusia), pushing 'include'.

L27n1559.name: Compound modifier before noun
L27n1559.description: The modifier in a technical compound just before its head noun (gas in 'gas giants', white in 'white dwarfs', sewer in 'sewer lines'), pushing 'main'.

L27n2302.name: Negative: list-item noun starts
L27n2302.description: Fires strongly negative on the first piece of a noun in a list (limes, rambutan, snails, dandelion), pushing em dashes.

L27n2090.name: Word-start fragments, 'theorem'
L27n2090.description: The opening piece of a long word split into tokens (enc in encroachment, rec in recycling, unp in unpasteurized), pushing 'theorem' or 'lemma'.

L27n2781.name: Word-fragment reads, prime writes
L27n2781.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments of multi-token words (Franc-, Pr-, Bl-); pushes toward 'prime'.

L27n1753.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1753.description: The first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (Hor in Horowitz, Char in Charlemagne, Har in Harbin), pushing 'none'.

L27n1408.name: Place/person name pieces
L27n1408.description: A piece of a place or person name split into tokens (Có in Córdoba, cro in Croesus, Y in Yehuda), pushing 'knowledge'.

L27n2774.name: Negative: name initial letters
L27n2774.description: Fires strongly negative on the first letter or piece of a name (K in Kourou, F in Faisal, Ze in Zeppelin), pushing 'equal'.

L27n1002.name: Negative: odd word pieces
L27n1002.description: Fires strongly negative on odd word pieces (-lo in self-love, ə in Middlesbrough, ste in steaming), pushing 'an' or 'as'.

L27n1384.name: Body/medical word pieces
L27n1384.description: A piece of a body or medical word split into tokens (oo in oozing, fec in feces, tent in tentacles), pushing 'lower' or 'upper'.

L27n496.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n496.description: A digit inside a number or year (the 2 in 27.2°C, the 8 in 1989, the 9 in 1982), pushing 'six' or '6'.

L27n236.name: Negative: technical word pieces
L27n236.description: Fires strongly negative on pieces of split technical words and names (ish in Torrey, ux in bruxism, cos in glycosylated), pushing 'Al' or 'Ab'.

L27n1050.name: Negative: assistant reply start
L27n1050.description: Fires strongly negative on the first token of the assistant's reply after '<|im_start|>assistant', pushing 'go'.

L27n1127.name: Negative: word-piece fragments
L27n1127.description: Fires strongly negative on fragments of split words (ah in docosahexaenoic, os in osteosarcoma, st in stearic), pushing 'less' or 'low'.

L27n1390.name: Negative: name fragments, 'information'
L27n1390.description: Fires strongly negative on mid-name pieces (az in oxazolidinones, at in somatostatin, kes in Waukesha), pushing 'information'.

L27n2562.name: Negative: 'ground' before zero
L27n2562.description: Fires strongly negative on the word 'ground' in 'ground zero', 'ground level' and 'groundwater', pushing 'zero'.

L27n1517.name: Capitalized name fragments
L27n1517.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a capitalized name or title split across tokens, e.g. 'Medical' in 'Hughes Medical', 'Fl' in Flax, 'Fr' in Franks; pushes toward the letter 'y'.

L27n2620.name: Word-start pieces, Africa
L27n2620.description: Fires (negative) on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'sa' in sauté, 'sm' in smacking, 'sc' in scorpion, 'M' in Maccabean; pushes toward nationality and country words like African, Nigerian, Brazilian.

L27n2850.name: ALL-CAPS acronym pieces
L27n2850.description: Fires on the middle or end piece of an ALL-CAPS acronym or capitalized term split into tokens, e.g. 'LE' in LEAs, 'TE' in INTELLIGENCE, 'CE' in CEZ, 'IDE' in IDEO; pushes toward 'th', 'nd', 'rd' ordinal endings.

L27n373.name: Non-English word pieces
L27n373.description: Fires on articles and word pieces inside non-English passages, e.g. Spanish 'la' after 'Banco Mundial analiza', German 'Welt', Polish 'ń', Japanese 'を'; pushes toward Portuguese and Spanish nouns like diferença, exemplo, acesso, senha.

L27n1435.name: Mid-word fragments, spend
L27n1435.description: Fires (negative) on a short piece inside a long word split across tokens, e.g. 'op' in Neoplatonic, 'oc' in tocopherol, 'ely' in Thelypteridaceae, 'C' in Cacao; pushes toward spend, spent, spending, expenditure.

L27n182.name: Digits and units, math
L27n182.description: Fires on digits inside numbers and scientific notation (e.g. '1' in 1.5 × 10^8, '4' in 14.7 °C) and on unit or math tokens like °, ×, Celsius, Fahrenheit; pushes toward logarithm, algorithm, quadratic, mathematical.

L27n2763.name: Word-start pieces, strict
L27n2763.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most often 't' or 'T' starting tinnitus, tiredness, tangle, and 'Arist' in Aristotelian; pushes toward strict, strictly, tight, stringent.

L27n868.name: Name-middle pieces, school
L27n868.description: Fires on a word piece that begins the second half of a split proper name or term, e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Phar' in Pharrell, 'Ph' in Ph.D., 'imp' in impurities; pushes toward school, schools, teacher.

L27n572.name: Numeral pieces, seven
L27n572.description: Fires on odd number and name pieces, e.g. '9' in 1979, '7' in 787, '⁴' in ¹⁴C, 'Bad' in Badlands, 'Se' in Seeds; pushes toward 7, seven, Seven.

L27n1439.name: Post-name pieces, lead
L27n1439.description: Fires on the piece right after a name or term inside a compound or list, e.g. 'the' before 'bass clave', 'and' in National Oceanic and Atmospheric, 'Dev' in Devonta; pushes toward lead, leading, leads.

L27n1526.name: Demonym suffix pieces, step
L27n1526.description: Fires on the suffix piece of demonyms and -ian or -ic adjectives, e.g. '-lian' in Karelian, '-rian' in Assyrian, '-ian' in Calydonian, '-an' in Sayan; pushes toward step and steps.

L27n2193.name: cl and f word-starts
L27n2193.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'cl' in clenching, clippings, clowns, 'f' in bullfrogs, and hyphen-letters like '-l' and '-g'; pushes toward 'non' prefixes.

L27n1416.name: Cont- word starts, control
L27n1416.description: Fires on the 'cont' piece opening containment, control and uncontrollable (e.g. 'uncont' in uncontrollable, 'Cont' in containment), often in disease or infection text; pushes toward control and controlling.

L27n93.name: Verbs of giving, names
L27n93.description: Fires on give, gave, given, giving and similar verbs of transfer (e.g. 'gave' in 'gave me some very good ideas'); pushes toward person names like Bob, Carol, Arnold.

L27n821.name: Person-name first pieces
L27n821.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a person's name split into tokens, e.g. 'Clem' in Clemenceau, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'Eli' in Elián; pushes toward handle and handles.

L27n974.name: Mid-word pieces, number
L27n974.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long or split names and terms, e.g. 'filtration' in glomerular filtration, 'os' in tyrannosaurus, 'T' in Talmud, 'musical' in high school musical; pushes toward number and numbers.

L27n2854.name: Proper-name second parts, D
L27n2854.description: Fires on the piece of a multi-word proper or institution name that follows its first word, e.g. 'Educational' in Individuals with Disabilities Educational Act, 'Heart' in American Heart, 'Intelligent' in IEEE Intelligent Systems; pushes toward the letter D.

L27n2212.name: Word-start f and H
L27n2212.description: Fires (negative) on a word-initial piece such as 'f' in bullfrogs, 'H' in Hertford, 'F' in Fossil, 'sh' in shut down, 'unf' in unfunded; pushes toward && and and.

L27n1602.name: Chat turn-end tokens
L27n1602.description: Fires (negative) on the chat-template boundary after a user message, the '<|im_end|>' and newline before '<|im_start|>assistant', and also on 'onta' in Devonta; pushes toward Polish and Italian word endings like -ja and -zione.

L27n1003.name: Word-start fragments, open
L27n1003.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'orth' in orthopaedic, 'fr' in frayed, 'anche' in Blanche, 'oste' in osteoporosis, 'wide' in wide-ranging; pushes toward open and opens.

L27n1141.name: Proper-name fragment pieces
L27n1141.description: Negative on the second or later sub-token of a capitalized name split across tokens, e.g. 'Mend|elssohn', 'Derek Mah|on', 'Int|erscience', 'Roh|ini'. Pushes toward 'Apache' and 'uri' tokens, which read as unrelated; steered output shows no clear shift.

L27n1323.name: Word stem, s-suffix push
L27n1323.description: Positive on a short fragment inside a split word, e.g. 'wid|ows', 'water|-soluble', 'Ex|cretory', '-ex|posure', 'NOP|ASSWD', peaking on the fragment itself. Pushes toward 's' or 'S' tokens; steered output spams 'S' or 's'.

L27n1336.name: Name middle piece (c-words)
L27n1336.description: Positive on a middle sub-token of a capitalized name or place split across tokens, e.g. 'Sk|op|je' (Skopje), 'Sus|ilo', 'Jiang|su'. Pushes toward 'c'-initial word starts like 'cl', 'con', 'cac'; steered output repeats 'clack'.

L27n2679.name: Token after 'hard'
L27n2679.description: Negative on the token right after 'hard' that opens a compound, e.g. 'hard<-h>itting', 'hard<w>ired', 'hard<w>obbling'; also on 'w' or 'h' word openers like 'Rose|Hips' and 'Sea|water'. Pushes toward 'hard' and 'soft'; steered output spams 'hard'.

L27n693.name: Modifier before noun
L27n693.description: Negative on a modifier word or sub-word just before the noun it describes, e.g. 'primary| learning styles', 'New| England', 'Primary| School', 'hip| hop'; top tokens are scattered word fragments. Pushes toward 'number' and 'Number'; steered output spams 'number'.

L27n1411.name: Bare 't' word-opener
L27n1411.description: Negative on a bare 't' or 'T' token that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. 'for t|ummy time', 'a personal countert|op', 'flat-t|opped'. Pushes toward 'top', the 't' plus 'op' completion; steered output spams 'top'.

L27n2066.name: Word piece, pushes 'figure'
L27n2066.description: Positive on a sub-token in the middle of a split name or word, right before its last piece, e.g. 'Tra|uma', 'ple|ural', 'Lak|shmi', 'Hil|figer', 'Mach|egonne'. Pushes toward 'figure' and 'Figure'; steered output spams 'figure'.

L27n389.name: Age and sex slots
L27n389.description: Negative on diffuse function words and nouns in child, pet and livestock text, peaking on the slot just before an age, sex or animal-kind word, e.g. 'castrated males [as] wethers', 'kitten [was] born', 'world [animal] protein'. Pushes toward 'sex', 'gender', 'adult' and 'Woman'; steered output drifts into 'worn worn'.

L27n1030.name: Second part after hyphen
L27n1030.description: Negative on the first letters of a hyphenated or split second part, e.g. 'golden-b|rown', 'ste|amer', 'IN|TE|LLIGENCE', 'Middles|b|rough'. Pushes toward capital 'L' tokens; steered output spams 'L' or 'Ll'.

L27n2096.name: Name piece, pushes 'new'
L27n2096.description: Positive on a sub-token inside a proper name or loanword, e.g. 'Lord S|iva', 'Lak|shmi', 'Tur|abian', 'Ph|raya Nakhon', 'Gar|uda'. Pushes toward adjectives like 'andere', 'neue' and 'erste' (other, new, first); steered output reads as ordinary prose.

L27n1977.name: Lone f/d word-opener
L27n1977.description: Positive on a lone 'f', 'd', 'D' or 'F' token that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. 'a f|ad', 'the d|uchy', 'the f|able', 'F|ERPA', 'Acid iph|ilium'. Pushes toward 'work' and 'works'; steered output spams 'work'.

L27n1129.name: Verb stem before -ate
L27n1129.description: Positive on a verb stem split from its ending, right before '-ate' or '-ise', e.g. 'educ|ates', 'narr|ates', 'motiv|ates', 'irrit|ates', 'rehe|ated'. Pushes toward 'ate', 'ise' and 'ates'; steered output spams 'ate'.

L27n755.name: Slot before descriptor adjective
L27n755.description: Positive on the token right before a physical-description adjective in plant, animal or product prose, e.g. 'a [short] period', 'rather [orange]', 'very [deep]', 'white [with] yellow tips', plus commas that set up a list of traits. Pushes toward adjectives such as deep, wide, strong, thick and short; steered output spams 'deep'.

L27n184.name: Punctuation opening an aside
L27n184.description: Negative on a punctuation mark that opens an aside or alternative right after a term: '(' before a converted value or acronym, '/' or '&' between two options, '=' in a code assignment. Pushes toward code identifiers like 'str', 'id', 'url' and 'len'; steered output spams 'str' and 'strid'.

L27n588.name: Onset 'pr/cr/str' fragment
L27n588.description: Negative on a consonant-cluster onset fragment that opens a split word, mostly 'pr', 'cr', 'str' or 'sar', e.g. 'forest-dwelling pr|imate', 'cr|anes', 'str|angleweed', 'sar|coma'. Pushes toward 'condition' and 'case'; steered output spams 'condition'.

L27n241.name: Named-entity start
L27n241.description: Positive on the first sub-token of a capitalized name, place or institution, e.g. 'Carnegie', 'Cornell', 'Astr|onomical', 'cath|edrals', 'Vol|canoes', and in chat answers on the token where a numbered list begins. Pushes toward digits 1 to 9; steered output spams '1'.

L27n274.name: Line break before code
L27n274.description: Positive on the line break after the empty think block, or on a colon, semicolon or bracket that opens a code answer or list. Pushes toward declaration keywords 'class', 'static' and 'public'; steered output spams 'class'.

L27n1880.name: Opening 'rec' fragment
L27n1880.description: Negative on the word-opening fragment 'rec' (recitation, recollections, recaptured) and other short onsets like 'gew', 'fl' and 'ew' inside split words. Pushes toward 'world' and 'World'; steered output spams 'world'.

L27n103.name: Opening paren or quote
L27n103.description: Negative on the opening '(' or quote mark that starts an aside, gloss or example right after a term, e.g. 'Dizziness (vertigo)', 'Btu (British Thermal Unit)', 'Medieval philosophy (Islamic Golden Age)'. Its output weights decode to nothing clear; steered output gives stray spaces and numbers.

L27n304.name: Mid-word piece in names
L27n304.description: Positive on the middle sub-token of a multi-piece word or name, mostly produce, pets and places, e.g. 'cant|al|ou|pe', 'Chatt|ahoo|chee', 'kettle|bell', 'lady|bugs', 'al-M|ab|hou'. Pushes toward generic nouns 'things', 'people', 'folks' and 'everybody'; steered output repeats 'things happen'.

L27n1145.name: Word-prefix fragment opener
L27n1145.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split or prefixed into tokens (sub-, inter-, re-, e-cigarette, hyper-, Mult-, Co-), mid-sentence in web text. Pushes the model toward the token 'text' and repeats 'Text'.

L27n2575.name: Split-word start, negative
L27n2575.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a word split across tokens, mostly names and nouns (Tr|ainers, bir|thing, Mon|et, Pl|ague, thr|ived). Pushes the model toward 'before' and repeats it.

L27n118.name: Technical tutorial tokens, diffuse
L27n118.description: Weak, diffuse negative drift across tutorial and code text. Peaks on numbers inside decimals or identifiers (0.01, 1.4), colons that open lists, and 'any' in instructions. Pushes toward 'ASCII', 'initialization' and 'README'.

L27n3007.name: Medical word-fragment opener
L27n3007.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split medical or technical word: 'cl' in clenching or clindamycin, 'ural' after 'ple' in pleural effusion, 'gl' in glaucoma or glider, 'Sw' in swelling. Pushes toward 'refer' and loops it.

L27n1933.name: Academic degree and major
L27n1933.description: Fires on the token after a degree or program word, and on word fragments in academic text ('CS' in 'CS degree', 'major' in 'majoring in history', 'Studies' in 'Liberal Studies', 'multim-'). Pushes toward 'major' and 'minor'.

L27n651.name: Recipe and listing nouns
L27n651.description: Goes negative on the first content word of a noun phrase in recipes, prompts and product copy ('dried' chamomile, 'f' in feta, 'green' beans, 'Christmas' outfit, 'screenplay', 'sandwich'). Pushes toward 'feel' and 'feeling'.

L27n470.name: Mid-name proper-noun continuation
L27n470.description: Fires on an inner piece of a multi-token proper name or title, usually the middle word or fragment (the 'ac' in Tic-Tac-Toe, 'ellen' in Hellenic, 'United' in UNESCO, 'Academy' in American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry). Pushes toward capital initial letters like D, S, T, C.

L27n1533.name: Medical prefix pieces, idioms
L27n1533.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of a medical word (hyp|op|arathyroidism, par|ap|legia) and on prepositions that close a fixed phrase ('on its way', 'at ease', 'up to date', 'on point'). Pushes toward 'par'.

L27n1579.name: Word fragments, stay/stand verbs
L27n1579.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments of split nouns (cl|enching, cant|aloupe, apr|icots, ot|ash) and on verbs of standing or staying ('stand up', 'stay behind', 'turn to'). Pushes toward 'put'.

L27n311.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n311.description: Fires on the first 2-3 letters of a word split into tokens, usually a consonant cluster ('squ' in squirts and squander, 'str' in strung, 'Sel' in Selaginellaceae, 'kne' in kneading, 'Kon' in Konwar). Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'owns' and 'ailable'.

L27n2439.name: Citation/URL/number punctuation
L27n2439.description: Goes negative on punctuation inside citations, URLs, dates and numbers: '(' in 4(2), '=' in a URL, '-' in 2021-05, '.' in 1.000.000, '//' and '&' in links. Pushes toward stray single letters like 's', 'S', 'O'.

L27n531.name: Capital B word starts
L27n531.description: Goes negative on a capital letter or fragment that opens a name or noun ('B' in Bicycles, Babbage, Bofors, Buthidae, Bortnyik; 'oc' in tocopherol; 'ant' in antlers). Pushes toward closing '?' and '!' punctuation.

L27n28.name: Ingredient-list commas, measures
L27n28.description: Fires on commas and the word 'the' inside long enumerations, and on measure words in recipes (tablespoons, minced, freshly, -sized). Pushes toward random capitalised tokens and repeated words like 'cinnamon'.

L27n270.name: Title-case heading words
L27n270.description: Goes negative on a capitalised word inside a title or heading ('Public' in Public Switched Telephone Network, 'Significant' in 'Significant Changes', 'Awareness', 'Comprehensive'), and on the colon or break that opens a heading. Pushes toward stray lowercase letters like p, q, k.

L27n1047.name: Term-start fragments, possessives
L27n1047.description: Fires on the first fragment of a drug name, proper name or content word that opens a clause ('am' in amikacin, 'Con' in Conventional, 'Pr' in Prussian, 'O' in Oceania). Pushes toward 'its' and 'their'.

L27n1173.name: Modifier before compound head
L27n1173.description: Fires on the modifier that opens a compound before its head noun ('flash' in flashcards and flashbacks, 'electron' before volts, 'lower' before limb, 'dust' before bowls, 'sewer' before lines, 'Iron' in Iron Lady). Pushes toward 'back'.

L27n687.name: Determiners before concrete nouns
L27n687.description: Goes negative on a determiner or preposition sitting right before the head noun of a phrase ('a', 'the', 'of', 'their', 'small', 'first', 'Royal'). Pushes toward concrete nouns like house, hand, box, road and boat.

L27n2291.name: Word-start 'pl' and '-p'
L27n2291.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments that open a split word, most often 'pl' (plume, plumb, plowing), '-p' after a hyphen (get-pip, shaded-pole, twisted-pair), and 'pr' or 'Pr'. Pushes toward 'zero'.

L27n1855.name: 'sign'/'qu' word starts
L27n1855.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most strongly 'sign' (sign language, significantly, sign of), 'qu' (quell, quasar), 'kin' (kinases), 'aqu' (aquarists) and 'phys' (physiotherapy). Pushes toward 'language'.

L27n2511.name: Word-start 'bre'/'cre'/'fl' fragments
L27n2511.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster piece that opens a split word ('bre' in breeder, 'cre' in crevice, 'fl' in flakes and flank, 'cr' in craton, 'al' in cantaloupe). Pushes toward 'difference'.

L27n1749.name: Mixed mid-phrase word pieces
L27n1749.description: Diffuse: negative on a word fragment or the first word of a name mid-sentence ('distra'ught, 'Dow' Chemical, 'carp'accio, 'Bour'ges); no single concept, pushes toward scattered tokens like 'writing' and 'hot'.

L27n1032.name: Opening fragments, 'affected'
L27n1032.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into subword tokens while the word is still unfinished ('thr|ong', 'exc|elled', 'uncon|scious', 'sh|rouded'); pushes toward 'affected', 'impacted' and 'damaged', so steering spams 'affected'.

L27n364.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n364.description: Fires on a digit or fraction in the middle of a number split across tokens (the '6' in 1863, the '7' in 787, the fraction '⅔'); pushes toward 'three', 'third' and '3', so steering spams 'Three'.

L27n1063.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1063.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a capitalized proper name ('G' in Garter, 'E' in Eunice, 'Har' in Harriette, 'Ban'); pushes toward the code token 'const'.

L27n1950.name: Split place-name fragments
L27n1950.description: Fires on a short piece that opens or sits inside a longer word split into tokens, mostly place and group names ('Te'sside, Eup'hr'ates, 'Cl'ifton, 'ph'agocytes); pushes toward 'your' and 'you'.

L27n1550.name: Nationality adjectives, 'import'
L27n1550.description: Fires on a nationality or country adjective placed before its noun ('Cuban', 'Soviet', 'Danish', 'German', 'Swedish', 'Australian'), and weakly on 'surre' in 'surrealist'; pushes toward 'import', so steering spams 'import'.

L27n492.name: Diffuse end-of-phrase tokens
L27n492.description: Diffuse: fires on the last word of a noun phrase or list item ('eggs', 'radishes', 'bread', 'inches') and on digits in measurements ('500 °C', '2000 mg'); no clear concept, pushes toward backslash tokens.

L27n1360.name: ALL-CAPS letter fragments
L27n1360.description: Fires on capital-letter pieces inside ALL-CAPS words and acronyms, mostly the second or later piece ('MESSENG|ER', 'CET|SHWAYO', 'IN|TELLIGENCE', 'CY|CLE', 'PO|C'); pushes toward more capital-letter pieces, especially 'E', so steering spams 'Eve'.

L27n1359.name: Auxiliaries before verbs
L27n1359.description: Fires on an auxiliary or infinitive marker just before its verb ('be' in 'will be abandoned', 'to' in 'to repair', 'is' in 'is cut', 'can' in 'can be', 'or' in 'or donated'); pushes toward 'real' and 'Real', so steering spams 'real'.

L27n650.name: Short word-opening fragments
L27n650.description: Fires on a short piece that opens a longer word split into tokens ('S'curvy, 'de'oxyguanosine, 'Ne'utron, 'blo'oming, 'Se'eded); pushes toward 'are' and 'were'.

L27n654.name: Mid-word fragments, 't' output
L27n654.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a word split across tokens, often the second piece ('pan/til|t', 'rebut|tal', 'forfe|it', 'interpre|ts', 'exoplan|et'); pushes toward a bare 't' as the next piece, so steering spams 't'.

L27n2855.name: Name-like word fragments
L27n2855.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece inside a longer name or word split across tokens, usually the second or third piece ('Kh|isa', 'Tong|a', 'chir|ping', 'mel|odic', 'Bel|oved', 'feng-sh|ui'); pushes toward 'energy', so steering spams 'Energy'.

L27n2634.name: Capital Ch/De word starts
L27n2634.description: Fires on a capitalized two-letter word start, mostly 'Ch' and 'De' ('Chronic', 'Chores', 'Deering', 'Dejnef'), plus 'St' and 'Wh'; pushes toward the pipe character '|'.

L27n582.name: List and clause joins
L27n582.description: Diffuse: fires on commas and conjunctions that join list items or clauses (', Asperger's', 'and PDD', 'is arguably'), plus 'heat' and 'before'; no single concept, pushes toward 'aware' and 'wish' words.

L27n1191.name: Rare-word middle piece
L27n1191.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a long or rare word split into tokens ('gor' in Novgorod, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'proph' in prophesied, 'ab' in law-abiding); pushes toward the suffix 'es'.

L27n1349.name: Short fragments, rare words
L27n1349.description: Fires on a short fragment, often 2 letters, that opens a rare, capitalised or technical word split across tokens ('tr|is', 'Bl|anche', 'Nec|rolestes', 'V|itiligo', 'TR|UL|Y'); pushes toward 'answer' and 'Answer', so steering spams 'answer'.

L27n1587.name: Word fragments, 'original' output
L27n1587.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long or technical names ('Kor|moran' as 'orm', 'melan|in', 'Sab|rina', 'ket|osis', 'ac|rophobia') and on some whole names ('Claude', 'Best'); pushes toward 'original' and 'originally', so steering spams 'original'.

L27n515.name: Conjunctions after noun phrases
L27n515.description: Fires on a conjunction or relative word ('and', 'or', 'that', 'which', 'these') right after a noun or clause, where a new clause or alternative starts ('allergies and forms', 'diseases or injuries', 'cells which'); pushes toward 'result', 'cause' and 'form'.

L27n698.name: Technical-term pieces
L27n698.description: Fires on a piece of a technical or name word split into tokens (bi'ostatistics, iod'iversity, gu'ayule, J'ørgensen, methyl tert-but'yl); pushes toward 'data'.

L27n861.name: Quantity words before nouns
L27n861.description: Fires on a quantity word or adjective right before the noun it modifies ('two' teeth, 'a few' organs, 'other' organs, 'numerous', 'sticky' foods, 'sensitive' skin); pushes toward 'company'.

L27n1285.name: Foreign word fragments
L27n1285.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a foreign name or word split across tokens (e.g. 'Cor' in Coruña, 'imar' in Guimarães, 'ichen' in Gleichenia, 'ラン' in 'home run'), where the next token completes the word; pushes toward short multilingual function words (Indonesian 'adalah'/'hanya', Italian 'è', Spanish 'puede'), and when steered it repeats 'only'.
